items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉經濟部擬赴德州設立產業園區、中經院三度上修今年GDP至12.16%
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News
paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1. 台灣計畫籌集數十億美元資金，在美國開發產業園區，為輝達(NVDA-US) 及其他台灣 AI 硬體製造商打造完整的供應鏈體系。經濟部長龔明鑫表示，這項計畫將從德州的一座園區起步，建置成本最高達 40 億美元。園區將協助中小型供應商赴美設廠，這些業者對輝達主要生產夥伴台積電(2330-TW) ，以及鴻海(2317-TW) 等 AI 伺服器組裝廠的營運至關重要。
2. 中華經濟研究院16日公布台灣全年經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值達12.16%，將創1988年來新高，主要是受惠人工智慧技術快速發展，成長模式呈現「內外皆熱」，而全年消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率為2.06%，相較其他國家通膨情勢仍屬平穩。

3. 台新新光金控子公司台新投顧與台新證券子公司元富投顧於16日正式完成合併，台新投顧為存續公司，存續名稱維持「台新證券投資顧問股份有限公司」。繼投信、壽險及證券期貨子公司之後，投顧成為金控旗下又一完成整併的子公司。合併後台新投顧員工逾80人，躋身國內規模最大的金控投顧之列。研究團隊依國際市場、科技產業、總經傳產、企業金融及整合行銷五大領域進行專業分工，集中集團研究資源、擴大研究覆蓋範圍與服務量能，目標成為「金控大腦」。
4. 鴻海(2317-TW)16日公告，透過旗下投資管理子公司利億國際投資，將與三菱電機株式會社正式簽訂策略聯盟協議，共同經營汽車設備事業；利億預計將以1150億日圓(約新台幣236億元)取得三菱電機移動株式會社(Mitsubishi Electric Mobility)50%股權，預計於2027年10月1日完成股權移轉交易。
5. 台股16日揮別昨日狂殺陰霾，指數盤中一度大漲500多點，惟終場權值股遭砍大單賣壓，僅上漲141.39點，站回4萬7千點，成交量縮至9,359億元，周K終結連4紅。外資今日再站賣方，調節台股461.47億元、連8賣，大賣台積電(2330-TW)2.2萬張，居賣超最大個股，大賣元大台灣50(0050-TW)2.8萬張。

Taiwan plans to raise tens of billions of US dollars to develop an industrial park in the United States, creating a complete supply‑chain ecosystem for Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and other Taiwanese AI hardware manufacturers. MOEA Minister Kung Ming‑hsin said the project will start with a park in Texas, with construction costs up to $4 billion. The park will help small and medium‑size suppliers set up factories in the U.S.; these firms are critical to Nvidia’s main manufacturing partner TSMC (2330‑TW) and AI server assemblers such as Foxconn (2317‑TW).

The Chung‑Hua Institution for Economic Research released on the 16th its latest full‑year GDP growth forecast for Taiwan at 12.16%, a new high since 1988, driven by rapid AI technology development and a “hot” domestic‑and‑foreign growth pattern. The forecasted annual CPI increase is 2.06%, indicating relatively stable inflation compared with other countries.

Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding’s subsidiaries Taishin Investment Advisory and Yuanta Investment Advisory completed their merger on the 16th. Taishin Investment Advisory will be the surviving entity, retaining the name “Taishin Securities Investment Advisory Co., Ltd.” Following the integration of its mutual‑fund, life‑insurance and securities‑futures subsidiaries, the investment‑advisory arm becomes another fully integrated unit under the holding company. Post‑merger, Taishin Investment Advisory employs over 80 staff, making it the largest financial‑holding investment‑advisory firm in Taiwan. Its research team is organized into five specialties—international markets, technology, traditional industries, corporate finance and integrated marketing—to pool group resources, broaden coverage and service capacity, aiming to become the “brain” of the financial holding group.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced on the 16th that through its investment‑management subsidiary Liyi International Investment, it will sign a strategic alliance agreement with Mitsubishi Electric Corp to jointly operate an automotive equipment business. Liyi plans to acquire a 50 % stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility for ¥115 billion (about NT$23.6 billion), with the share transfer expected to be completed on 1 October 2027.

The Taiwan stock market on the 16th shook off yesterday’s heavy sell‑off, with the index rallying more than 500 points intraday but closing with a modest gain of 141.39 points, back at 47,000 points. Turnover fell to NT$9.359 trillion, ending a four‑day streak of weekly red candles. Foreign investors were net sellers again, offloading NT$461.47 billion and marking an eighth consecutive day of net selling, including a massive sell‑off of TSMC (2330‑TW) of 22,000 lots—the largest net sell‑off for any stock—and a sell‑off of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) of 28,000 lots.

items.title: 票價只有高鐵五分之一 客運大巴重新火起來了
items.title_en: Bus Fares Only One-Fifth of High-Speed Rail, Intercity Buses Are Making a Comeback
paras: 居住在廣州的白領朵拉近幾年發現，從廣州到珠海，坐大巴不到人民幣（下同）15元，高鐵票約70元，大巴價格只有高鐵五分之一；廣州至深圳，大巴票價也僅有十幾元，也是高鐵票價的五分之一左右。
「價格低得難以置信。」朵拉現在經常坐大巴跨城出行。她選擇大巴的原因，除了票價，還有上車地點。
傳統長途客運往往需要乘客先到汽車客運站，再排隊、候車。如今，一些城際定制巴士把停靠點設在地鐵口、商圈和居民區附近。
對朵拉來說，少一次換乘、少一段前往車站的路程，比單純縮短車上的時間更實在。
購票也變得很快捷。「很多小程式都可以買，隨買隨走。」她說。
珠三角城際網約巴士平台「樣樣巴士」就有這樣的購票小程式，廣州到深圳單程票價是13.8元，深圳到東莞只需要8.8元。
據《第一財經》報導，樣樣巴士運營經理張鵬說，該平台主要服務跨城上班族、大學生、探親人群和短途出遊乘客。
與傳統客運不同，平台不再完全依賴汽車客運站，而是通過小程式售票、設置分散的上下客點，並根據客流調整班次。
「廣州到深圳，我們的票價只要十幾塊錢，高鐵要七、八十塊。」張鵬說，即便到節假日，票價也是這麼低，不會因為假期客流多就漲價。
在高鐵票定鬧鐘都搶不到的熱門假期，乘客通常只需要提前一小時在樣樣巴士小程式上買票，一小時後就能檢票上車。
對一些不趕時間、但對價格敏感的乘客而言，這種選擇的吸引力顯而易見——不但能少花幾十元，還能從離家更近的地方上車。
截至目前，樣樣巴士平台日均服務乘客1.2萬餘人次，節假日單日客流峰值達到3萬～3.5萬人次。張鵬說，核心通勤線路平峰上座率在70%以上，早晚高峰和周末可達到90%至100%。
類似變化也發生在西北地區。
在寧夏，天豹交運集團推出的「便民快巴」，瞄準的則是這樣一類出行需求：既想要正規、安全、方便的營運服務，又希望價格夠便宜。
「幾年前，我們的調查發現，高鐵、大巴等多種出行方式的票價區別不大，沒有拉開價差。此外，我們最大的競爭對手其實是『黑車』。」寧夏天豹交運集團副總經理韓曉磊說，一些沒有營運資質的車輛通過「上門接人」吸引不少乘客。
天豹交運因此給自己定下一個目標：便民快巴的票價要比「黑車」低一半左右，這樣即便沒法「上門接人」，價格也有足夠吸引力。
降價之後，乘客逐漸回來了。
以銀川至靈武線路為例，票價從22元降到了12元；銀川至吳忠線路的票價也從20元降至12元。
班次同樣發生了變化。韓曉磊說，傳統模式下，銀川至吳忠線路曾經一個小時才發一班車，客流不足時還會取消部分班次。便民快巴接手後，發車間隔逐步縮短，從30分鐘一班縮短到20分鐘一班，「現在一天有35班，往返70班，客座率還很高」。
目前天豹已開通12條便民快巴線路，投入133輛新能源客車，每日開行420餘班，日均服務旅客超過1.2萬人次。韓曉磊說，線路平均實載率約80%，節假日部分線路客座率可超過95%。
paras_en: Living in Guangzhou, white-collar worker Dora has noticed in recent years that a bus from Guangzhou to Zhuhai costs less than RMB 15, while a high‑speed rail ticket is about RMB 70 – the bus price is only one‑fifth of the rail fare; the Guangzhou‑Shenzhen bus fare is also only a few tens of yuan, roughly one‑fifth of the rail price as well.
"The price is unbelievably low," Dora says, and she now frequently takes intercity buses. Besides the fare, the location of the boarding point is another reason she prefers the bus.

Traditional long‑distance coaches usually require passengers to go to a bus station, then queue and wait. Nowadays, some customized intercity buses set their stops near subway exits, commercial districts and residential areas.
For Dora, having one fewer transfer and a shorter trip to the station is more valuable than merely shortening the time spent on the vehicle.
Ticket purchasing has also become very fast. "Many mini‑programs let you buy and ride instantly," she says.

The Guangdong‑Pearl River Delta intercity ride‑hailing platform "Yangyang Bus" offers such a mini‑program; a one‑way ticket from Guangzhou to Shenzhen costs RMB 13.8, and Shenzhen to Dongguan only RMB 8.8.

According to a report by First Financial, Yangyang Bus operations manager Zhang Peng said the platform mainly serves commuters, university students, family‑visiting travelers and short‑distance tourists.

Unlike traditional coaches, the platform no longer relies solely on bus stations; it sells tickets via mini‑programs, sets dispersed pick‑up and drop‑off points, and adjusts schedules according to passenger flow.

"Guangzhou to Shenzhen, our tickets are only a few tens of yuan, while high‑speed rail costs seventy or eighty yuan," Zhang said. Even during holidays the price stays low and does not rise with higher demand.

During peak holiday periods when high‑speed rail tickets are sold out, passengers only need to buy a ticket on the Yangyang Bus mini‑program an hour in advance and can board after the one‑hour check‑in.
For passengers who are not in a rush but are price‑sensitive, the appeal is obvious – they save dozens of yuan and can board from a location closer to home.

To date, the Yangyang Bus platform serves about 12,000 passengers per day on average, with holiday single‑day peaks reaching 30,000‑35,000. Zhang said core commuter routes have off‑peak load factors above 70%, and during morning‑evening peaks and weekends they reach 90%‑100%.
Similar changes are occurring in the northwest region.
In Ningxia, the Tianbao Transportation Group launched a "Convenient Fast Bus" aimed at travelers who want a formal, safe, convenient service at a low price.

"A few years ago our survey found that ticket price differences among high‑speed rail, buses and other modes were small, so there was no price gap. Our biggest competitor is actually the 'black car'," said Tianbao Transportation Group deputy general manager Han Xiaolei. Unlicensed vehicles attract many passengers by offering door‑to‑door pickup.
Therefore Tianbao set a goal: the Convenient Fast Bus fare should be about half that of a black‑car, so even without door‑to‑door service the price remains highly attractive.
After the price cut, passengers gradually returned.
For example, on the Yinchuan‑Lingwu route the fare fell from RMB 22 to RMB 12; the Yinchuan‑Wuzhong route also dropped from RMB 20 to RMB 12.

Schedules changed as well. Han said that under the traditional model the Yinchuan‑Wuzhong line ran only once per hour and sometimes cancelled trips due to low demand. After the Convenient Fast Bus took over, intervals shortened from 30 minutes to 20 minutes, "now there are 35 trips a day, 70 round trips, and seat occupancy remains high."

Tianbao now operates 12 Convenient Fast Bus routes, has deployed 133 new‑energy buses, runs over 420 trips daily, and serves more than 12,000 passengers per day on average. Han said the average load factor across routes is about 80%, and on some holiday routes the occupancy exceeds 95%.

items.title: 「不是債市太悲觀就是股市太樂觀！」 高盛警告背離近臨界點：AI股恐再跌15%  點名對沖台灣半導體
items.title_en: "Either the bond market is too pessimistic or the stock market is too optimistic!" Goldman Sachs warns divergence nearing a tipping point: AI stocks may fall another 15% and names Taiwan semiconductor hedge
paras: 美國股市與信貸市場對AI題材的定價，正出現明顯裂口。高盛出具最新研報指出，AI超大型雲端廠商(hyperscaler)的信貸利差已擴大至年內最寬，但對應股價尚未充分反映壓力。
高盛策略師Louis Miller指出，市場正面臨二選一，「不是債市悲觀過頭，就是股市還有約15%下行空間未被消化。」
高盛AI超大型雲端廠商信貸利差指數(GSUCHS30)上週升至今年新高。Miller指出，7月利差接近此水準時，相關股票價格較現行水準低約15%。
此外，高盛AI受益股籃子相對「剔除AI成分」的標普500指數，已自6月高點回落約25%。信貸市場通常對現金流、融資成本與違約風險更敏感，這次率先反應，顯示市場辯論核心已從「AI需求有多強」轉向「資本支出能否回收」。
壓力不只在雲廠。超大型雲端廠商信用違約交換(CDS)觸及歷史新高，更下層的垃圾債市場中，20檔AI資料中心債券中有7檔還款來源依賴單一租戶CoreWeave，而CoreWeave債券殖利率已飆至15%左右、落入困境級區間。高盛認為，這是AI融資鏈從核心向外圍蔓延的訊號。
核心解釋在資本支出增速觸頂。高盛估算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出年增率約在今年第三季見頂(116%)，之後逐季放緩，2027年底降至約20%，重點不在總額立刻下滑，而在市場過去按「持續加速」給估值，一旦增速轉平，回報假設就要重算。
與此同時，折舊反噬是下一顆未爆彈。高盛測算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出扣除折舊後淨值，對標普EPS成長的貢獻，2026年約+11個百分點、2027年降至+7個百分點，2028年隨大量資料中心資產進入攤提高峰，貢獻轉為-1個百分點，原本支撐高獲利的AI投資，增速過後會變成利潤表拖累。
市場內部指標也同步轉弱。看跌選擇權成交量上週五(16日)升至年內次高水位；高盛高貝塔因子組合較高點跌15%；周期股相對防禦股隱含經濟成長預期降至約2%；避險基金貝塔調整後淨部位處在五年第67百分位、淨槓桿僅第17百分位，顯示「想跟AI順勢」但槓桿沒跟上。金融條件由正轉負，更高利率與更寬利差直接壓負債依賴股。
不過，Miller並未斷言指數崩盤，而是稱市場正以輪動消化壓力，並給出五項應對策略：一、做多剔除AI的寬基市場，AI與非AI相關性已轉負；二、做多品質因子但防技術面過熱，質量因子三個月漲20%、RSI破80；三、中期醫療保健，押ACA補貼延長帶動就醫流量；四、做多巴西非相關機會，總統決選舉行前後估值有重估空間；五、對沖台灣半導體部位，因台積電調高指引後股價仍偏弱，亞洲團隊建議做空台灣半導體籃子。
對投資人而言，高盛這份周報的重點不是「AI結束」，而是定價階段切換：股價還在講成長，債市已開始算折舊與融資成本。若信貸利差續擴，AI概念股補跌風險將從邊緣租戶、NeoCloud、光通訊與記憶體鏈，逐步回推至核心雲巨頭與半導體龍頭。
paras_en: The pricing of AI themes in U.S. equities and credit markets is showing a clear split. Goldman Sachs' latest research note says credit spreads for AI hyperscale cloud providers have widened to the widest level this year, yet stock prices have not yet fully reflected the pressure.
Goldman strategist Louis Miller notes the market faces a binary choice: "Either the bond market is overly pessimistic, or the stock market still has about 15% downside not yet priced in."

The Goldman AI hyperscale cloud credit spread index (GSUCHS30) rose to a new high for the year last week. Miller points out that when spreads were near this level in July, the related stock prices were roughly 15% lower than current levels.

Moreover, the basket of AI beneficiary stocks relative to the S&P 500 "excluding AI components" has fallen about 25% from its June peak. Credit markets, which are more sensitive to cash flow, financing costs and default risk, reacted first, indicating the debate has shifted from "how strong AI demand is" to "whether capital spending can be recouped."

The pressure isn’t limited to cloud providers. Credit default swaps on hyperscale cloud firms hit historic highs, and in the junk bond market, 7 of 20 AI data‑center bonds rely on a single tenant, CoreWeave, whose bond yields have surged to roughly 15% and entered distressed territory. Goldman sees this as a signal that AI financing is spreading from the core to the periphery.

The core issue is a peak in capital‑expenditure growth. Goldman estimates hyperscale cloud cap‑ex annual growth will top out in Q3 this year at about 116%, then slow each quarter, falling to roughly 20% by the end of 2027. The focus isn’t an immediate drop in total spend, but the market’s valuation built on a "continuous acceleration" narrative, which must be re‑calculated once growth flattens.

At the same time, depreciation backlash is the next hidden bomb. Goldman calculates that after subtracting depreciation, the net contribution of hyperscale cloud cap‑ex to S&P EPS growth will be about +11 percentage points in 2026, drop to +7 points in 2027, and turn negative (‑1 point) in 2028 as massive data‑center assets hit peak amortization, turning what once supported high AI profits into a profit‑and‑loss drag.

Internal market indicators are also weakening. Put‑option volume rose to the second‑highest level of the year last Friday (the 16th); Goldman’s high‑beta factor portfolio is down 15% from its peak; cyclical stocks’ implied growth expectations relative to defensive stocks have fallen to about 2%; hedge‑fund beta‑adjusted net positions sit at the 67th percentile of the past five years and net leverage at the 17th percentile, showing a desire to ride the AI wave without sufficient leverage. Financial conditions have turned negative, with higher rates and wider spreads directly squeezing debt‑heavy stocks.

However, Miller does not predict a full index collapse. He says the market is rotating to absorb pressure and outlines five strategies: 1) go long the broad market excluding AI, as AI‑related and non‑AI assets are now negatively correlated; 2) go long quality factors while avoiding an overheated tech side—quality factors have risen 20% in three months and RSI has broken 80; 3) mid‑term healthcare, betting on extended ACA subsidies driving patient volume; 4) go long Brazil’s non‑correlated opportunities, where valuation could be reset around the presidential election; 5) hedge Taiwan semiconductor exposure, as TSMC’s stock remains weak despite raised guidance, with the Asian team recommending shorting a Taiwan semiconductor basket.

For investors, the key takeaway from Goldman’s weekly note isn’t that "AI is over," but that the pricing phase is shifting: stocks are still talking growth, while the bond market is already pricing depreciation and financing costs. If credit spreads keep widening, the risk of further AI‑related stock pull‑backs will move from edge tenants, NeoCloud, optical‑communication and memory chains back toward core cloud giants and semiconductor leaders.

items.title: 破天荒！韓媒：三星將採台積電3奈米製程  為輝達生產下一代HBM基底裸片
items.title_en: Breaking Ground! Korean Media: Samsung to Use TSMC 3nm Process for Nvidia's Next-Gen HBM Base Dies
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，南韓三星電子將打破長達數年的「一站式全包」生產模式，採用台積電的3奈米製程，為輝達下一代HBM製造基底裸片(base die)。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》今(18)日引述消息人士報導，輝達已向三星、SK海力士及美光三家供應商提出統一要求，基底裸片必須使用台積電3奈米工製成，核心裸片則統一採用第六代DRAM工藝(1c)，這一要求源於各供應商製造方案差異導致性能不穩，標準化可大幅減輕輝達的驗證工作量。
報道指出，三星設備解決方案事業部經內部評估後，決定接受輝達要求。三星此次調整僅針對輝達客製化的HBM4E產品。對於標準版HBM及面向超微等其他客戶的產品，三星仍將保留全包生產策略。
目前，三星已全球率先量產第六代HBM4，第七代HBM4E正進行量產驗證，兩款產品的基底裸片均採用三星自研4奈米製程。
值得注意的是，三星並未完全放棄自主生產能力。一位業內人士透露，三星正同步驗證能否在自有產線製造輝達HBM基底裸片，作為防範台積電產能不足的備案，此舉顯示在AI晶片競爭白熱化下，三星正以靈活策略平衡技術自主與客戶需求。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that South Korea's Samsung Electronics will break its years‑long "single‑source full‑pack" production model and adopt TSMC’s 3‑nanometer process to make the base dies for Nvidia’s next‑generation HBM.

Korean outlet Seoul Economic Daily cited sources saying Nvidia has issued a unified request to its three suppliers—Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron—that the base dies be fabricated with TSMC’s 3nm technology, while the core dies use a sixth‑generation DRAM process (1c). The demand stems from performance instability caused by differing manufacturing approaches, and standardisation would greatly reduce Nvidia’s validation workload.

The report says Samsung’s Equipment Solutions division, after an internal review, decided to meet Nvidia’s request. The adjustment applies only to Nvidia‑customised HBM4E products; for standard‑edition HBM and products for other customers such as AMD, Samsung will retain its full‑pack production strategy.

Samsung is currently the first worldwide to mass‑produce sixth‑generation HBM4, and seventh‑generation HBM4E is undergoing volume‑production qualification. Both products’ base dies are made with Samsung’s own 4‑nanometer process.

It is noteworthy that Samsung has not completely abandoned its own manufacturing capability. An industry insider disclosed that Samsung is simultaneously testing whether it can produce Nvidia’s HBM base dies on its own lines as a contingency in case TSMC capacity falls short, showing that amid the fierce AI‑chip battle Samsung is using a flexible strategy to balance technological independence with customer needs.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉AI供應鏈遭外資提款壓力驟增 等待摸底訊號
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: AI Supply Chain Faces Surge in Foreign Investor Redemptions, Awaiting Bottoming Signal
paras: 美股恐慌指數VIX 飆漲， 費城半導體指數上周五更大跌近4%，而台積電法說行情並未發酵，台股上周也重挫2202點，跌幅達4.4%，台股交易員提醒，利多不漲，本周大盤不排除直測季線46000點附近支撐，在新台幣爆量重挫的壓力下，短線空方氣勢高漲，就看能否迅速出現摸底訊號。
上周外資在台股集中市場重手提款多達5862億元，儘管投信呈現你丟我撿，祭出買盤達881億元，仍難圍起強烈支撐。

其中，外資主要賣超元大台灣50(0050-TW)近27萬張最多，其次為主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)25.5萬張，主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)23.4萬張，主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)和力積電(6770-TW)均達19萬張，主動復華未來50(00991A-TW)9.8萬張，台積電(2330-TW)9.7萬張，南亞科(2408-TW)9萬張，聯電(2303-TW)近7萬張，以及台塑(1301-TW)達6.3萬張。
若以金額來看，外資上周從台積電提走達2415億元，聯發科(2454-TW)達751億元，南亞科433億元，台達電(2308-TW)376億元，元大台灣50近300億元。
台股交易員認為，台股在觸及5萬點關卡前利多不漲，甚至賣壓重重，主要反映美國通膨壓力、各種國際上的系統性風險，並非台股本身基本面疑慮，需靜待強勁的低接買盤出現，本周先保守看待國際各種金融情勢變化。
永豐投顧則指出，雖美國CPI較預期高，但預期聯準會 10 月按兵不動的機率較高，而在短中期內油價不易回落之下，年內再升一次的方向沒有改變。
永豐投顧認為，小心通膨引發的升息預期導致科技股評價下調，但長期布局仍然是相當好的點位，可以在台股空頭消息仍在但跌幅收斂甚至反彈時作布局，但可能會需要等候2周或以上。
paras_en: The US VIX volatility index spiked, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell nearly 4% last Friday. Meanwhile, TSMC’s earnings‑related rally failed to materialise, and the Taiwan stock market slumped 2,202 points last week, a 4.4% drop. Traders warned that without any upside from positive news, the market could test the seasonal 46,000‑point support this week. Under the pressure of a massive NTD‑denominated sell‑off, short‑term bearish momentum is strong, and everything hinges on whether a bottoming signal appears quickly.

Last week foreign investors withdrew a massive NT$586.2 billion from Taiwan’s listed market. Although domestic mutual funds tried to step in, buying NT$88.1 billion, it was insufficient to provide strong support.

Among the biggest sellers were foreign investors offloading 270,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), followed by 255,000 shares of Active Zhongxin Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), 234,000 shares of Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), 190,000 shares each of Active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Powerchip (6770‑TW), 98,000 shares of Active Fuhua Future 50 (00991A‑TW), 97,000 shares of TSMC (2330‑TW), 90,000 shares of Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), about 70,000 shares of UMC (2303‑TW), and 63,000 shares of Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW).

In terms of value, foreign investors pulled out NT$241.5 billion from TSMC, NT$75.1 billion from MediaTek (2454‑TW), NT$43.3 billion from Nanya Technology, NT$37.6 billion from Delta Electronics (2308‑TW), and roughly NT$30 billion from Yuanta Taiwan 50.

Market participants believe that before the index reaches the 50,000‑point milestone, positive news is not lifting the market and selling pressure remains heavy. This reflects US inflation concerns and various systemic risks abroad rather than doubts about Taiwan’s fundamentals. Investors should wait for a strong, low‑price buying wave and adopt a cautious stance toward evolving global financial conditions this week.

Everbright Investment Advisory notes that although US CPI came in higher than expected, the odds are higher that the Fed will hold rates steady in October. With oil prices unlikely to fall in the short‑ to medium‑term, the outlook of another rate hike within the year remains unchanged.

Everbright warns that inflation‑driven expectations of further rate hikes could depress tech‑stock valuations, but they still see long‑term positioning as attractive. They suggest building positions when bearish news persists but the decline narrows or rebounds, though investors may need to wait two weeks or more for such an opportunity.

items.title: 從聖彼得堡到莫斯科州 俄羅斯多地遭大規模無人機襲擊
items.title_en: From St. Petersburg to Moscow Oblast, Russia Hit by Large-Scale Drone Attacks
paras: 俄羅斯國防部18日（周日）通報，自17日20時至18日8時，境內多地遭無人機襲擊，防空部隊在別爾哥羅德州、布良斯克州、列寧格勒州、莫斯科州等地及黑海上空攔截、擊落1,015架烏克蘭無人機。
《塔斯社》稱，此次無人機襲擊為今年來最大規模襲擊之一。
俄羅斯聖彼得堡市市長別格洛夫18日在社交媒體上說，聖彼得堡當日凌晨遭無人機襲擊，已造成1人死亡、5人受傷。
俄羅斯航空署稱，聖彼得堡普爾科沃機場當天已暫停飛機起降，乘客和工作人員均被疏散至安全地區。
俄羅斯列寧格勒州州長德羅茲堅科18日在社交媒體上說，該州當天凌晨共擊落144架無人機。無人機殘骸墜落導致當地一座公寓大樓、一棟民宅和供電線路受損，部分地區斷電。
俄羅斯國防部18日表示，武裝部隊繼續對烏克蘭物流中心、港口及船隻實施打擊，造成烏克蘭羅夫諾市一處用於儲存和分發無人機部件等貨物的物流中心受損。
此外，俄軍還在敖德薩港以東30公里處打擊一艘載有軍民兩用貨物的乾貨船。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基18日表示，自美國總統川普宣布「能源停火」以來，俄羅斯已對烏克蘭能源和油氣產業發動76次打擊。
本月18日凌晨，烏文尼察州、日托米爾州、赫梅利尼茨基州和敖德薩州的變電站遭襲，導致數萬家庭斷電。俄軍當天還襲擊居民住宅，造成12人受傷、2人死亡。
澤倫斯基說，俄軍過去一周發射近2,700架無人機、1,700枚航空炸彈和66枚飛彈，其中大部分為彈道飛彈。俄軍的主要目標是能源設施。
paras_en: The Russian Ministry of Defence reported on Sunday the 18th that from 20:00 on the 17th to 08:00 on the 18th, multiple regions of the country were attacked by drones, and air‑defence forces intercepted and shot down 1,015 Ukrainian drones over Belgorod, Bryansk, Leningrad, Moscow oblasts and the Black Sea airspace.
TASS said the drone attacks were among the largest of the year.
St. Petersburg Mayor Alexander Beglov said on social media that the city was hit by a drone attack in the early hours of the day, killing one person and injuring five.
The Russian Federal Air Transport Agency said that flights at St. Petersburg’s Pulkovo Airport were suspended that day and passengers and staff were evacuated to safe areas.

Leningrad Oblast Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on social media that the region shot down 144 drones in the early hours, and debris from the drones damaged an apartment block, a private house and power lines, causing power outages in some areas.

The Defence Ministry said the armed forces continued to strike Ukrainian logistics centres, ports and vessels, damaging a logistics hub in the city of Rovenky that stored and distributed drone components and other goods.
In addition, Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship carrying dual‑use cargo about 30 km east of the port of Odesa.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on the 18th that since U.S. President Donald Trump announced an “energy cease‑fire,” Russia has carried out 76 attacks on Ukraine’s energy and oil‑gas sector.

In the early hours of the 18th, substations in the Ukrainian regions of Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi and Odesa were hit, cutting power to tens of thousands of households, and Russian forces also attacked residential buildings, wounding 12 people and killing two.
Zelensky said Russian forces in the past week launched nearly 2,700 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs and 66 missiles, most of them ballistic, with energy facilities being the main target.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：Meta及特斯拉財報、AI漲勢動搖、Fed升息預期
paras: 隨著引領市場的AI交易近期遭遇挫折，華爾街本週將聚焦Meta Platforms(META-US)等重要企業即將公布的財報，市場也將藉此檢驗投資人對這波漲勢的信心。
AI概念股票是這波美股多頭行情的核心，而這波行情才剛迎來四週年。然而，相關類股近幾日表現疲弱，半導體公司及戴爾科技(DELL-US)等科技硬體企業股價大幅下跌。
Meta是大舉投資AI資料中心建設的超大規模雲端服務商之一，將成為這週財報季焦點之一。此外，半導體設備商科林研發(LRCX-US)、德州儀器(TXN-US)，以及馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉 (TSLA-US)也將公布財報。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions投資組合策略師Garrett Melson表示，「市場目前的氛圍確實有些不安。顯然AI目前的發展方向仍存在許多不確定性。」
市場近期開始擔憂AI基礎建設熱潮的融資風險。這波投資熱潮推升了許多企業的獲利，也帶動經濟成長。投資人密切關注AI雲端公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US)最新發展，該公司負債約500億美元，上週股價重挫。
其他謹慎訊號還包括，德銀與加拿大皇家銀行資本市場策略師近期分別下調對科技類股的看好程度。德銀策略師10月9日表示，資金輪動至科技股的行情「已經走得太遠，短期內的風險報酬前景不再有利」。
受到大型科技股與AI類股大幅下跌拖累，標普500指數上週創6月以來最大單週跌幅。不過，該指數距離本月創下的歷史高點仍僅約2%。相較之下，上個月因科技股強勢而落後的其他類股表現穩健，醫療保健與民生必需品類股均有所上漲。
Melson表示，「這確實是一個行情開關不斷切換的市場。當AI類股表現強勢時，就會吸走其他所有類股的市場關注度。」

Meta打頭陣 大型雲端業者財報登場

美股財報季熱度升溫，投資人期待企業交出強勁成績。根據LSEG IBES，標普500成分股企業第三季獲利預計年增逾30%。
AI資料中心與基礎設施的大規模支出，是推動獲利成長的重要因素。高盛估計，Meta在內的五家AI超大規模雲端服務商，明年資本支出合計預計將增至約1.2兆美元。投資人正急於尋找訊號，確認這些企業能從相關投資中獲得回報，以建立對這種支出模式可持續性的信心。
紐約梅隆銀行股票分析師Kevin Shea表示，「財報季最重要的觀察重點之一，是超大規模雲端服務商的獲利成長速度，能否超越資本支出的成長速度。」
Meta市值約1.8兆美元，近期隨著公司推出Muse AI助理，股價有所上漲。
Horizon Investment Services執行長Chuck Carlson表示，「隨著資金成本上升，這種大幅擴張的資本支出將變得更加昂貴，也進一步提高了投資報酬的門檻。Meta將率先公布財報，市場也將期待公司對這個問題提供更多說明。」

半導體廠、特斯拉接力公布財報

晶片公司一直是這波資本支出熱潮最大受益者之一，但相關股票近期漲勢已經降溫。費城半導體指數本月下跌約12%，儘管如此，今年以來仍上漲57%，遠高於標普500指數約12%的年初至今漲幅。
科林研發與德州儀器週三公布的財報，可能為半導體產業的整體需求提供更廣泛訊號。科林研發今年以來股價上漲54%，德州儀器則上漲59%。
投資人也將關注馬斯克旗下兩家市值遠超過1兆美元的企業財報：同時經營AI業務的太空公司SpaceX，以及作為科技股帶動美股多頭行情代表之一的特斯拉。
其他本週將公布財報的重要企業，還包括串流媒體公司Netflix(NFLX-US)、消費用品公司寶僑(PG-US)，以及航空引擎製造商GE Aerospace(GE-US)。

聯準會10月升息預期降溫

美國公債殖利率上升，以及聯準會(Fed)可能進一步升息的前景，也仍是投資人關注焦點。
上週公布的高於預期的通膨數據，一度提高了市場對聯準會在10月底會議再次升息的押注。不過，期貨價格顯示，多數投資人仍預期美國央行將等到12月會議，才進行今年第二次升息。
瑞銀全球財富管理分析師週四在報告中表示，「如果本次財報季表現同樣強勁，將有助於股市抵禦利率溫和上升帶來的壓力。」
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。

items.title: 法國55萬人大遊行 1,200人被捕 馬克宏發聲
items.title_en: France 550,000 People March, 1,200 Arrested, Macron Speaks Out
paras: 法國內政部長洛朗·努內茲17日（周六）就國內各地抗議活動和警方應對措施發布最新消息，各地當天共舉行了110場遊行，共計55萬名抗議者參與，這是法國近年來最嚴重暴力騷亂之一。
法國總理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科爾努表示，約1,200人被捕。法國警察工會UNSA在X平台上發布了一段影片，顯示多地人群用棍棒和磚塊襲擊警車，並警告警方已不堪重負。
巴黎市中心著名地標，包括香榭麗舍大街、協和廣場、共和國廣場等，都發生抗議活動。許多商店和餐館被砸，汽車和垃圾桶被縱火焚燒。
法國中西部上維埃納省利摩日市市政廳被縱火，這座擁有140年歷史的建築的女兒牆在火災中坍塌。
當地官員莫里斯·巴拉特表示，該建築「除西翼外，屋頂已坍塌至較低樓層，且三分之二外牆已經消失。」巴拉特稱，市政廳所受嚴重破壞是「文化遺產災難」，譴責相關舉動是「流氓蓄意行徑」。
《法新社》援引目擊者消息稱，一群蒙面抗議者在市政廳外焚燒一輛警車後，砸碎窗戶闖入大樓縱火。
里昂旅遊局辦公室遭縱火，當地照片顯示，辦公室窗戶被砸碎，整棟建築被火焰吞噬。
法國總統馬克宏表示，絕不容忍暴力。「那些破壞、襲擊政府機關與商鋪、甚至洗劫市政廳的人，都會被起訴、懲處。」馬克宏在帖文中說。
paras_en: France's interior minister Laurent Nunez announced on Saturday that protests took place across the country, with 110 marches on the day and a total of 550,000 demonstrators, making it one of the most severe bouts of violence in recent years.

Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said about 1,200 people were arrested. The police union UNSA posted a video on X showing crowds in multiple locations attacking police cars with clubs and bricks, warning that police were overwhelmed.

Major landmarks in central Paris, including the Champs‑Élysées, Place de la Concorde and Place de la République, saw protests. Many shops and restaurants were smashed, and cars and trash cans were set on fire.
The town hall in Limoges, in the Haute‑Vienne department of central‑western France, was set ablaze; the 140‑year‑old building’s south wall collapsed in the fire.

Local official Maurice Baratte said the building’s “roof has collapsed down to lower floors except for the west wing, and two‑thirds of the exterior walls have disappeared.” He called the severe damage a “cultural‑heritage disaster” and condemned the act as “deliberate hooligan behaviour.”
AFP cited eyewitnesses who said a group of masked protesters set a police car on fire outside the town hall, then smashed windows to break into the building and set it alight.
The Lyon tourism office was torched; photos showed its windows shattered and the entire structure engulfed in flames.

President Emmanuel Macron said violence would not be tolerated. “Those who vandalise, attack government offices and shops, or even loot town halls will be prosecuted and punished,” he wrote in a post.

items.title: 「不是債市太悲觀就是股市太樂觀！」 高盛警告背離近臨界點：AI股恐再跌15%  點名對沖台灣半導體
items.title_en: "Either the bond market is too pessimistic or the stock market is too optimistic!" Goldman Sachs warns divergence nearing a tipping point: AI stocks may fall another 15% and names Taiwan semiconductor hedge
paras: 美國股市與信貸市場對AI題材的定價，正出現明顯裂口。高盛出具最新研報指出，AI超大型雲端廠商(hyperscaler)的信貸利差已擴大至年內最寬，但對應股價尚未充分反映壓力。
高盛策略師Louis Miller指出，市場正面臨二選一，「不是債市悲觀過頭，就是股市還有約15%下行空間未被消化。」
高盛AI超大型雲端廠商信貸利差指數(GSUCHS30)上週升至今年新高。Miller指出，7月利差接近此水準時，相關股票價格較現行水準低約15%。
此外，高盛AI受益股籃子相對「剔除AI成分」的標普500指數，已自6月高點回落約25%。信貸市場通常對現金流、融資成本與違約風險更敏感，這次率先反應，顯示市場辯論核心已從「AI需求有多強」轉向「資本支出能否回收」。
壓力不只在雲廠。超大型雲端廠商信用違約交換(CDS)觸及歷史新高，更下層的垃圾債市場中，20檔AI資料中心債券中有7檔還款來源依賴單一租戶CoreWeave，而CoreWeave債券殖利率已飆至15%左右、落入困境級區間。高盛認為，這是AI融資鏈從核心向外圍蔓延的訊號。
核心解釋在資本支出增速觸頂。高盛估算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出年增率約在今年第三季見頂(116%)，之後逐季放緩，2027年底降至約20%，重點不在總額立刻下滑，而在市場過去按「持續加速」給估值，一旦增速轉平，回報假設就要重算。
與此同時，折舊反噬是下一顆未爆彈。高盛測算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出扣除折舊後淨值，對標普EPS成長的貢獻，2026年約+11個百分點、2027年降至+7個百分點，2028年隨大量資料中心資產進入攤提高峰，貢獻轉為-1個百分點，原本支撐高獲利的AI投資，增速過後會變成利潤表拖累。
市場內部指標也同步轉弱。看跌選擇權成交量上週五(16日)升至年內次高水位；高盛高貝塔因子組合較高點跌15%；周期股相對防禦股隱含經濟成長預期降至約2%；避險基金貝塔調整後淨部位處在五年第67百分位、淨槓桿僅第17百分位，顯示「想跟AI順勢」但槓桿沒跟上。金融條件由正轉負，更高利率與更寬利差直接壓負債依賴股。
不過，Miller並未斷言指數崩盤，而是稱市場正以輪動消化壓力，並給出五項應對策略：一、做多剔除AI的寬基市場，AI與非AI相關性已轉負；二、做多品質因子但防技術面過熱，質量因子三個月漲20%、RSI破80；三、中期醫療保健，押ACA補貼延長帶動就醫流量；四、做多巴西非相關機會，總統決選舉行前後估值有重估空間；五、對沖台灣半導體部位，因台積電調高指引後股價仍偏弱，亞洲團隊建議做空台灣半導體籃子。
對投資人而言，高盛這份周報的重點不是「AI結束」，而是定價階段切換：股價還在講成長，債市已開始算折舊與融資成本。若信貸利差續擴，AI概念股補跌風險將從邊緣租戶、NeoCloud、光通訊與記憶體鏈，逐步回推至核心雲巨頭與半導體龍頭。
paras_en: The pricing of AI themes in U.S. equities and credit markets is showing a clear split. Goldman Sachs' latest research note says credit spreads for AI hyperscale cloud providers have widened to the widest level this year, yet stock prices have not yet fully reflected the pressure.
Goldman strategist Louis Miller notes the market faces a binary choice: "Either the bond market is overly pessimistic, or the stock market still has about 15% downside not yet priced in."

The Goldman AI hyperscale cloud credit spread index (GSUCHS30) rose to a new high for the year last week. Miller points out that when spreads were near this level in July, the related stock prices were roughly 15% lower than current levels.

Moreover, the basket of AI beneficiary stocks relative to the S&P 500 "excluding AI components" has fallen about 25% from its June peak. Credit markets, which are more sensitive to cash flow, financing costs and default risk, reacted first, indicating the debate has shifted from "how strong AI demand is" to "whether capital spending can be recouped."

The pressure isn’t limited to cloud providers. Credit default swaps on hyperscale cloud firms hit historic highs, and in the junk bond market, 7 of 20 AI data‑center bonds rely on a single tenant, CoreWeave, whose bond yields have surged to roughly 15% and entered distressed territory. Goldman sees this as a signal that AI financing is spreading from the core to the periphery.

The core issue is a peak in capital‑expenditure growth. Goldman estimates hyperscale cloud cap‑ex annual growth will top out in Q3 this year at about 116%, then slow each quarter, falling to roughly 20% by the end of 2027. The focus isn’t an immediate drop in total spend, but the market’s valuation built on a "continuous acceleration" narrative, which must be re‑calculated once growth flattens.

At the same time, depreciation backlash is the next hidden bomb. Goldman calculates that after subtracting depreciation, the net contribution of hyperscale cloud cap‑ex to S&P EPS growth will be about +11 percentage points in 2026, drop to +7 points in 2027, and turn negative (‑1 point) in 2028 as massive data‑center assets hit peak amortization, turning what once supported high AI profits into a profit‑and‑loss drag.

Internal market indicators are also weakening. Put‑option volume rose to the second‑highest level of the year last Friday (the 16th); Goldman’s high‑beta factor portfolio is down 15% from its peak; cyclical stocks’ implied growth expectations relative to defensive stocks have fallen to about 2%; hedge‑fund beta‑adjusted net positions sit at the 67th percentile of the past five years and net leverage at the 17th percentile, showing a desire to ride the AI wave without sufficient leverage. Financial conditions have turned negative, with higher rates and wider spreads directly squeezing debt‑heavy stocks.

However, Miller does not predict a full index collapse. He says the market is rotating to absorb pressure and outlines five strategies: 1) go long the broad market excluding AI, as AI‑related and non‑AI assets are now negatively correlated; 2) go long quality factors while avoiding an overheated tech side—quality factors have risen 20% in three months and RSI has broken 80; 3) mid‑term healthcare, betting on extended ACA subsidies driving patient volume; 4) go long Brazil’s non‑correlated opportunities, where valuation could be reset around the presidential election; 5) hedge Taiwan semiconductor exposure, as TSMC’s stock remains weak despite raised guidance, with the Asian team recommending shorting a Taiwan semiconductor basket.

For investors, the key takeaway from Goldman’s weekly note isn’t that "AI is over," but that the pricing phase is shifting: stocks are still talking growth, while the bond market is already pricing depreciation and financing costs. If credit spreads keep widening, the risk of further AI‑related stock pull‑backs will move from edge tenants, NeoCloud, optical‑communication and memory chains back toward core cloud giants and semiconductor leaders.

items.title: 破天荒！韓媒：三星將採台積電3奈米製程  為輝達生產下一代HBM基底裸片
items.title_en: Breaking Ground! Korean Media: Samsung to Use TSMC 3nm Process for Nvidia's Next-Gen HBM Base Dies
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，南韓三星電子將打破長達數年的「一站式全包」生產模式，採用台積電的3奈米製程，為輝達下一代HBM製造基底裸片(base die)。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》今(18)日引述消息人士報導，輝達已向三星、SK海力士及美光三家供應商提出統一要求，基底裸片必須使用台積電3奈米工製成，核心裸片則統一採用第六代DRAM工藝(1c)，這一要求源於各供應商製造方案差異導致性能不穩，標準化可大幅減輕輝達的驗證工作量。
報道指出，三星設備解決方案事業部經內部評估後，決定接受輝達要求。三星此次調整僅針對輝達客製化的HBM4E產品。對於標準版HBM及面向超微等其他客戶的產品，三星仍將保留全包生產策略。
目前，三星已全球率先量產第六代HBM4，第七代HBM4E正進行量產驗證，兩款產品的基底裸片均採用三星自研4奈米製程。
值得注意的是，三星並未完全放棄自主生產能力。一位業內人士透露，三星正同步驗證能否在自有產線製造輝達HBM基底裸片，作為防範台積電產能不足的備案，此舉顯示在AI晶片競爭白熱化下，三星正以靈活策略平衡技術自主與客戶需求。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that South Korea's Samsung Electronics will break its years‑long "single‑source full‑pack" production model and adopt TSMC’s 3‑nanometer process to make the base dies for Nvidia’s next‑generation HBM.

Korean outlet Seoul Economic Daily cited sources saying Nvidia has issued a unified request to its three suppliers—Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron—that the base dies be fabricated with TSMC’s 3nm technology, while the core dies use a sixth‑generation DRAM process (1c). The demand stems from performance instability caused by differing manufacturing approaches, and standardisation would greatly reduce Nvidia’s validation workload.

The report says Samsung’s Equipment Solutions division, after an internal review, decided to meet Nvidia’s request. The adjustment applies only to Nvidia‑customised HBM4E products; for standard‑edition HBM and products for other customers such as AMD, Samsung will retain its full‑pack production strategy.

Samsung is currently the first worldwide to mass‑produce sixth‑generation HBM4, and seventh‑generation HBM4E is undergoing volume‑production qualification. Both products’ base dies are made with Samsung’s own 4‑nanometer process.

It is noteworthy that Samsung has not completely abandoned its own manufacturing capability. An industry insider disclosed that Samsung is simultaneously testing whether it can produce Nvidia’s HBM base dies on its own lines as a contingency in case TSMC capacity falls short, showing that amid the fierce AI‑chip battle Samsung is using a flexible strategy to balance technological independence with customer needs.

paras_en: The US VIX volatility index spiked, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell nearly 4% last Friday. Meanwhile, TSMC’s earnings‑related rally failed to materialise, and the Taiwan stock market slumped 2,202 points last week, a 4.4% drop. Traders warned that without any upside from positive news, the market could test the seasonal 46,000‑point support this week. Under the pressure of a massive NTD‑denominated sell‑off, short‑term bearish momentum is strong, and everything hinges on whether a bottoming signal appears quickly.

Last week foreign investors withdrew a massive NT$586.2 billion from Taiwan’s listed market. Although domestic mutual funds tried to step in, buying NT$88.1 billion, it was insufficient to provide strong support.

Among the biggest sellers were foreign investors offloading 270,000 shares of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), followed by 255,000 shares of Active Zhongxin Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), 234,000 shares of Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), 190,000 shares each of Active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) and Powerchip (6770‑TW), 98,000 shares of Active Fuhua Future 50 (00991A‑TW), 97,000 shares of TSMC (2330‑TW), 90,000 shares of Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), about 70,000 shares of UMC (2303‑TW), and 63,000 shares of Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW).

In terms of value, foreign investors pulled out NT$241.5 billion from TSMC, NT$75.1 billion from MediaTek (2454‑TW), NT$43.3 billion from Nanya Technology, NT$37.6 billion from Delta Electronics (2308‑TW), and roughly NT$30 billion from Yuanta Taiwan 50.

Market participants believe that before the index reaches the 50,000‑point milestone, positive news is not lifting the market and selling pressure remains heavy. This reflects US inflation concerns and various systemic risks abroad rather than doubts about Taiwan’s fundamentals. Investors should wait for a strong, low‑price buying wave and adopt a cautious stance toward evolving global financial conditions this week.

Everbright Investment Advisory notes that although US CPI came in higher than expected, the odds are higher that the Fed will hold rates steady in October. With oil prices unlikely to fall in the short‑ to medium‑term, the outlook of another rate hike within the year remains unchanged.

Everbright warns that inflation‑driven expectations of further rate hikes could depress tech‑stock valuations, but they still see long‑term positioning as attractive. They suggest building positions when bearish news persists but the decline narrows or rebounds, though investors may need to wait two weeks or more for such an opportunity.

items.title: 搶救荷包看這裡！營所稅暫繳還沒辦 最遲「這天」補繳省利息
items.title_en: Save Your Wallet Here! Corporate Income Tax Estimated Payments Not Yet Filed Must Be Made by This Date to Avoid Interest
paras: 用曆年制的營利事業115年度營利事業所得稅暫繳申報期間已於9月30日截止，若有尚未辦理暫繳申報及繳納稅款的企業，務必把握在10月31日以前完成補報與補繳，此舉不僅能避免稽徵機關逕行核定暫繳稅額，更能有效減輕後續產生的利息負擔，呼籲各大企業主與財務人員盡快檢視帳務並完成申報作業。

財政部台北國稅局針對營利事業所得稅暫繳申報相關規定指出，依據所得稅法第67條以及第68條相關條文規範，營利事業如果在10月31日以前辦理補報及補繳暫繳稅額，應自10月1日起至實際補繳暫繳稅額之日止，按其應繳納之暫繳稅額，依115年1月1日郵政儲金1年期定期儲金固定利率1.725計算，按日加計利息一併徵收。若是超過10月31日仍然未辦理暫繳申報的營利事業，稽徵機關將會按照該企業114年度營利事業所得稅結算申報應納稅額的二分之一來核算暫繳稅額，同時加計1個月的利息後發單通知企業，並要求在15日內完成繳納，以免衍生更多財務與合規成本。
為了方便各大企業盡速完成補報補繳程序，台北國稅局說明，營利事業可以選擇在10月31日以前登入財政部稅務入口網自行列印附有條碼的繳款書，或者直接前往國稅局所屬的各分局、稽徵所以及服務處索取紙本繳款書進行填寫。完成填寫後，企業可就近前往各代收稅款的金融機構進行臨櫃繳納，不過需要特別注意的是郵局並不代收這類稅款，因此請企業務必選擇一般金融機構辦理繳納，以免白跑一趟並延誤寶貴的繳稅時效。
隨著10月31日的截止期限逐漸逼近，台北國稅局再次向社會各界呼籲，尚未完成115年度營利事業所得稅暫繳申報的企業，切勿心存僥倖或拖延至最後一刻，應盡速於期限內補辦相關手續並持繳款書完成補繳。愈早完成申報與繳納作業，就能夠節省愈多的利息支出，不僅能降低企業整體的營運成本，也能避免後續面臨稽徵機關逕行核定以及加徵滯納利息等額外負擔，確保企業在競爭激烈的市場中財務運作順暢無礙。
paras_en: The filing period for the 2026 corporate income tax estimated payments under the calendar-year system ended on September 30. Companies that have not yet filed or paid their estimated taxes must complete the amendment and payment by October 31. Doing so not only prevents the tax authority from unilaterally determining the estimated tax amount, but also significantly reduces the interest that would accrue later. Enterprises and their finance staff are urged to review their accounts promptly and finish the filing process.

The Ministry of Finance’s Taipei National Taxation Bureau explains that, according to Articles 67 and 68 of the Income Tax Act, if a corporation files and pays its estimated tax before October 31, interest will be calculated daily from October 1 until the actual payment date, using the fixed one‑year postal savings rate of 1.725% effective January 1, 2026. If a corporation fails to file the estimated tax by October 31, the tax authority will assess the estimated tax at half of the corporation’s 2025 corporate income tax settlement amount, add one month’s interest, issue a notice, and require payment within 15 days to avoid further financial and compliance costs.

To help companies complete the amendment and payment quickly, the Taipei National Taxation Bureau says corporations can log into the Ministry of Finance’s tax portal before October 31 to print a payment slip with a barcode, or obtain a paper slip at any tax office, branch, or service center. After completing the slip, the payment can be made at any authorized financial institution. Note that post offices do not collect this tax, so companies should use regular banks to avoid wasted trips and missed deadlines.

As the October 31 deadline approaches, the Taipei National Taxation Bureau again urges all businesses that have not yet filed their 2026 corporate income tax estimated payments not to gamble or procrastinate until the last minute. Complete the necessary procedures and submit the payment slip within the deadline. The earlier the filing and payment, the more interest savings a company can achieve, lowering overall operating costs and avoiding additional penalties such as unilateral assessments and late‑payment interest, thereby ensuring smooth financial operations in a competitive market.

items.title: 〈智慧能源週〉淨零展、智慧能源周3天吸引1.8萬專業買主 聚焦AI時代兼顧能源與減碳需求
items.title_en: Smart Energy Week: Net‑Zero Expo and Smart Energy Week Attract 18,000 Professional Buyers Over Three Days, Focusing on AI‑Era Energy and Decarbonization Needs
paras: 由外貿協會與SEMI旗下GESA綠能暨永續發展聯盟(GESA)攜手主辦的2026「台灣國際淨零永續展」與「台灣國際智慧能源周」上周圓滿落幕，據貿協統計今年共匯聚超過430家參展企業及近1,400個攤位，3天展期總計吸引近18,000名國內外專業買主與業界人士參觀，前五大買主國依序為新加坡、日本、韓國、美國以及越南，顯示淨零永續與能源韌性議題，已成為全球產業共同關注的焦點。
此次展覽共辦理79場採購洽談會，邀集來自波蘭、匈牙利、美國、加拿大、保加利亞、英國、以色列、羅馬尼亞、日本、巴西、埃及、烏克蘭、義大利、墨西哥等14國國際買主及產業代表參與，促成國際市場需求與台灣產業供應鏈量能交流，深化技術、應用與需求之間的鏈結。
貿協表示，在AI時代能源需求加速、國際淨零要求升高的雙重趨勢下，穩定、高效率與低碳能力已成為產業的核心競爭力，主辦單位為此亦積極串聯半導體、高科技製造及能源產業等需求方與供應鏈夥伴，透過媒合交流與產業對話，共同探討AI時代下兼顧能源韌性、經濟發展與減碳需求的可行路徑，藉由跨域合作能量，強化台灣淨零永續與能源韌性的競爭力。

其中「淨零未來實戰論壇」邀集國內外產業專家分享綠色轉型、永續金融及減碳實務經驗，探討企業邁向淨零過程中的挑戰與契機，星展集團作為台灣綠能融資的重要推手，累計參與逾5GW再生能源專案融資，並透過創新金融服務加速能源轉型與淨零目標實現；「旗艦專題暨 Power Next｜微電網與能源管理創新論壇」則聚焦 AI 與半導體先進製造帶動的高用電需求，探討韌性電網、微電網及智慧能源管理等關鍵解方，凸顯穩定供電與能源效率對高科技產業持續發展的重要性。
此外，首度舉辦的「生物多樣性與氣候韌性共榮論壇」及「淨零轉型 × 碳市場驅動永續論壇」，分別從自然資本、供應鏈風險、碳市場與製造業低碳轉型切入，拓展企業永續治理的實踐面向；「AI引領能源科技創新與未來轉型」與「2026台捷氫能戰略論壇」則聚焦AI驅動下的綠電需求、智慧能源及氫能產業合作，從技術創新延伸至跨國市場布局。
貿協指出，本屆展會以淨零永續、太陽光電、風力能源、智慧儲能應用及多元創能五大展區為核心，呈現能源轉型與淨零發展的最新技術與解決方案，因應 AI 與資料中心快速發展帶動的用電需求，眾多參展企業同步展出 AIDC、智慧能源管理、供電解決方案及儲能應用等創新技術。
貿協也預告明(2027)年「淨零永續展」與「智慧能源周」將於10月27日至29日在南港展覽館一館登場，持續打造亞洲重要的能源與淨零產業交流平台。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan International Net‑Zero Sustainable Expo and Taiwan International Smart Energy Week, co‑hosted by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA) and GESA, the Green Energy and Sustainable Development Alliance under SEMI, concluded successfully last week. TAITRA reports that more than 430 exhibiting companies and nearly 1,400 booths gathered, drawing close to 18,000 domestic and overseas professional buyers and industry participants over the three‑day exhibition. The top five buyer countries were Singapore, Japan, South Korea, the United States and Vietnam, showing that net‑zero sustainability and energy resilience have become global industry focal points.

The event featured 79 procurement matchmaking sessions, inviting international buyers and industry representatives from 14 countries—including Poland, Hungary, the United States, Canada, Bulgaria, the United Kingdom, Israel, Romania, Japan, Brazil, Egypt, Ukraine, Italy and Mexico—to engage with Taiwan’s supply chain, fostering exchange of market demand and capacity, and deepening links among technology, applications and needs.

TAITRA noted that under the dual trends of accelerating energy demand in the AI era and rising international net‑zero requirements, stability, high efficiency and low‑carbon capability have become core competitive advantages. Accordingly, the organizers actively linked demand‑side players from the semiconductor, high‑tech manufacturing and energy sectors with supply‑chain partners, using matchmaking and industry dialogues to explore feasible pathways that balance energy resilience, economic development and decarbonization in the AI age, and to strengthen Taiwan’s competitiveness in net‑zero sustainability and energy resilience through cross‑domain collaboration.

The “Net‑Zero Future Practical Forum” gathered domestic and foreign experts to share experiences on green transformation, sustainable finance and carbon‑reduction practices, discussing challenges and opportunities for companies moving toward net‑zero. DBS Group, a key driver of green‑energy financing in Taiwan, has participated in financing over 5 GW of renewable projects and is accelerating energy transition and net‑zero goals through innovative financial services. The “Flagship Session and Power Next | Micro‑grid and Energy Management Innovation Forum” focused on the high electricity demand driven by AI and advanced semiconductor manufacturing, examining resilient grids, micro‑grids and smart energy management solutions, underscoring the importance of stable power supply and energy efficiency for the continued growth of high‑tech industries.

In addition, the inaugural “Biodiversity and Climate Resilience Co‑Prosperity Forum” and the “Net‑Zero Transformation × Carbon Market‑Driven Sustainability Forum” approached corporate sustainability governance from the angles of natural capital, supply‑chain risk, carbon markets and low‑carbon manufacturing transformation. The “AI‑Led Energy Technology Innovation and Future Transformation” and the “2026 Taiwan‑Japan Hydrogen Energy Strategy Forum” centered on AI‑driven green power demand, smart energy and hydrogen industry collaboration, extending from technological innovation to cross‑border market deployment.

TAITRA highlighted that this year’s exhibition centered on five core zones—net‑zero sustainability, solar photovoltaics, wind energy, smart storage applications and diversified renewable generation—showcasing the latest technologies and solutions for energy transition and net‑zero development. Responding to the surge in electricity demand from AI and data‑center growth, many exhibitors simultaneously displayed innovative technologies such as AIDC, smart energy management, power supply solutions and storage applications.

TAITRA also announced that the 2027 Net‑Zero Sustainable Expo and Smart Energy Week will be held from October 27‑29 at Hall 1 of the Nangang Exhibition Center, continuing to build an important Asian platform for energy and net‑zero industry exchange.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉煉油利差維持高檔+荷姆茲商船遇襲 台塑化周漲10.86%
items.title_en: Hot Stocks: Refining Margins Stay High, Houthi Attack on Shipping, Formosa Plastics Chemical Up 10.86% This Week
paras: 台塑化(6505-TW)上周受惠「金九銀十」旺季加持，煉油利差維持強勁，加上荷姆茲海峽新加玻商船10月14日遭開火遇襲，中東戰事情勢升級，持續推升油價走勢上揚，雖然外資轉賣，但在投信連17買支援下，周漲10.86%，周K連收7紅，單周成交量爆增至35.6萬張。
法人表示，台塑化因中東情勢持續延燒，影響原油管線設施安全，加上沙烏地阿拉伯與伊朗支持的青年運動交火、荷姆茲海峽遇襲及傳美國有機會對伊朗核設施再次發動打擊，持續推升油價走勢上揚，也對台塑化股價呈現激勵效果。
據英國海上貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)事故通報，本(10)月已有逾20艘船隻在荷姆茲海峽、波斯灣及阿曼灣遭到攻擊，其中多數為油輪。
包括西德州、布蘭特原油期貨(Brent)持續位於每桶100美元以上高檔價格，布蘭特原油期貨在10月16日甚至爆漲觸及每桶110美元，也創今(2026)年5月來首見新高價。
此外，台塑化在第3季後因煉油價差擴大，煉油營業額年增31.8%，產能利用率回升至91.2%，單季稅後淨利季增26.5％，也創下單季、今年前3季累計獲利創同期歷史新高。
展望未來，法人預期隨著全球進入秋冬季節、在歲修期與柴汽油備貨旺季下，台塑化第4季煉油價差仍有支撐，有助於煉製毛利維持後市強勁。
paras_en: Formosa Plastics Chemical (6505-TW) benefited from the "golden September, silver October" peak season last week, with refining margins remaining strong. The October 14 attack on a Singapore‑flagged vessel in the Hormuz Strait, along with escalating Middle‑East tensions, continued to push oil prices higher. Although foreign investors sold, the stock rose 10.86% supported by institutional investors buying for the 17th consecutive week, closing seven red candles on the weekly chart and seeing weekly volume surge to 356,000 contracts.

Institutional investors said that the ongoing Middle‑East conflict, which threatens the safety of crude pipelines, the clash between Saudi‑backed and Iranian‑backed youth movements, the Hormuz Strait attack, and the possibility of the United States striking Iranian nuclear facilities again are all driving oil prices up, which in turn provides a boost to Formosa Plastics Chemical's share price.

According to a incident report from the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), more than 20 vessels have been attacked this month in the Hormuz Strait, the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman, most of them tankers.
West Texas Intermediate and Brent crude futures have remained above US$100 per barrel, with Brent spiking to US$110 on October 16, marking its highest level since May 2026.

In addition, after Q3 Formosa Plastics Chemical saw a widening refining spread, its refining revenue grew 31.8% year‑on‑year, capacity utilization rose to 91.2%, and quarterly net profit after tax increased 26.5%, setting new historical highs for both the quarter and the cumulative profit for the first three quarters of the year.

Looking ahead, institutions expect that as the global market moves into the autumn‑winter season and enters the peak period for diesel and gasoline stockpiling, Formosa Plastics Chemical's Q4 refining spread will remain supported, helping to sustain strong downstream margins.

items.title: 〈友達運動會〉半導體領域相關業務成長快速 彭双浪：目標成為先進封裝重要夥伴
items.title_en: <AUO Sports Day> Rapid Growth in Semiconductor-Related Business; Peng Shuanglang: Aiming to Become a Key Partner in Advanced Packaging
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)積極拓展半導體領域，董事長彭双浪表示，子公司布局半導體製程所需的關鍵工具、零組件或是服務，相關業務成長快速，而在先進封裝布局以「成為封裝廠的重要夥伴」為目標，而非取代現有廠商。
彭双浪表示，友達在玻璃封裝有車用衛星天線的經驗，但目前並不具備完整IC封裝能力，也沒有要轉型成為封裝公司，而是希望發揮對玻璃材料及製程的了解，與既有封裝業者協同合作，成為重要供應商。
彭双浪說明，AI晶片愈做愈大，晶片下方的基板（Substrate）必須符合更高要求，包括翹曲及熱阻抗等特性，現有PCB板未來可能難以滿足大型或高密度晶片的需求，因此玻璃基板已成為下一代先進封裝的重要發展方向。
他指出，友達從玻璃加工技術出發，布局金屬化、重布線層（RDL）、穿孔及中介層（Interposer）等領域，相關新技術平台預期約2至3年後達到一定成熟度，並希望先開始小量出貨。
以友達目前半導體布局來看，彭双浪表示，友達精材長期投入半導體製程所需工具及零組件，例如Dummy Substrate、Ring等產品，目前營收已全部來自半導體相關業務，此外，友達宇沛永續等子公司也提供半導體相關服務。
彭双浪進一步指出，目前部分子公司成長快速，雖然以友達集團約2,800億元營收規模來看，相關業務若要達到一定占比，仍需要擴大規模，但更重視這些事業是否進入正確的產業方向，以及未來的成長率。
paras_en: Panel giant AUO (2409‑TW) is actively expanding into the semiconductor sector. Chairman Peng Shuanglang said the subsidiary is positioning key tools, components and services needed for semiconductor processes, and that related businesses are growing quickly. In advanced packaging, the goal is to become an important partner for packaging factories, not to replace existing vendors.

Peng explained that AUO has experience in glass packaging for automotive satellite antennas, but currently does not have full IC‑packaging capability and does not intend to transform into a packaging company. Instead, it wants to leverage its knowledge of glass materials and processes to cooperate with existing packagers and become a major supplier.

He noted that AI chips are getting larger, and the substrate beneath the chip must meet higher standards for warp and thermal resistance. Existing PCB boards may struggle to satisfy the needs of large or high‑density chips, making glass substrates an important development direction for next‑generation advanced packaging.

Peng pointed out that starting from its glass‑processing expertise, AUO is building capabilities in metallization, redistribution layers (RDL), through‑holes and interposers. The new technology platform is expected to reach a certain level of maturity in about two to three years, with an aim to begin small‑volume shipments first.

Regarding AUO’s current semiconductor footprint, Peng said AUO Precision Materials has long invested in tools and components required for semiconductor processes, such as dummy substrates and ring products, and now all of its revenue comes from semiconductor‑related business. In addition, subsidiaries such as AUO Yupei Sustainable also provide semiconductor‑related services.

Peng added that some subsidiaries are growing rapidly. Although the AUO Group’s overall revenue is about NT$280 billion, the semiconductor‑related businesses would need to scale up to achieve a significant share. More important, however, is ensuring these ventures are heading in the right industry direction and have strong future growth rates.

items.title: 「不是債市太悲觀就是股市太樂觀！」 高盛警告背離近臨界點：AI股恐再跌15%  點名對沖台灣半導體
items.title_en: "Either the bond market is too pessimistic or the stock market is too optimistic!" Goldman Sachs warns divergence nearing a tipping point: AI stocks may fall another 15% and names Taiwan semiconductor hedge
paras: 美國股市與信貸市場對AI題材的定價，正出現明顯裂口。高盛出具最新研報指出，AI超大型雲端廠商(hyperscaler)的信貸利差已擴大至年內最寬，但對應股價尚未充分反映壓力。
高盛策略師Louis Miller指出，市場正面臨二選一，「不是債市悲觀過頭，就是股市還有約15%下行空間未被消化。」
高盛AI超大型雲端廠商信貸利差指數(GSUCHS30)上週升至今年新高。Miller指出，7月利差接近此水準時，相關股票價格較現行水準低約15%。
此外，高盛AI受益股籃子相對「剔除AI成分」的標普500指數，已自6月高點回落約25%。信貸市場通常對現金流、融資成本與違約風險更敏感，這次率先反應，顯示市場辯論核心已從「AI需求有多強」轉向「資本支出能否回收」。
壓力不只在雲廠。超大型雲端廠商信用違約交換(CDS)觸及歷史新高，更下層的垃圾債市場中，20檔AI資料中心債券中有7檔還款來源依賴單一租戶CoreWeave，而CoreWeave債券殖利率已飆至15%左右、落入困境級區間。高盛認為，這是AI融資鏈從核心向外圍蔓延的訊號。
核心解釋在資本支出增速觸頂。高盛估算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出年增率約在今年第三季見頂(116%)，之後逐季放緩，2027年底降至約20%，重點不在總額立刻下滑，而在市場過去按「持續加速」給估值，一旦增速轉平，回報假設就要重算。
與此同時，折舊反噬是下一顆未爆彈。高盛測算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出扣除折舊後淨值，對標普EPS成長的貢獻，2026年約+11個百分點、2027年降至+7個百分點，2028年隨大量資料中心資產進入攤提高峰，貢獻轉為-1個百分點，原本支撐高獲利的AI投資，增速過後會變成利潤表拖累。
市場內部指標也同步轉弱。看跌選擇權成交量上週五(16日)升至年內次高水位；高盛高貝塔因子組合較高點跌15%；周期股相對防禦股隱含經濟成長預期降至約2%；避險基金貝塔調整後淨部位處在五年第67百分位、淨槓桿僅第17百分位，顯示「想跟AI順勢」但槓桿沒跟上。金融條件由正轉負，更高利率與更寬利差直接壓負債依賴股。
不過，Miller並未斷言指數崩盤，而是稱市場正以輪動消化壓力，並給出五項應對策略：一、做多剔除AI的寬基市場，AI與非AI相關性已轉負；二、做多品質因子但防技術面過熱，質量因子三個月漲20%、RSI破80；三、中期醫療保健，押ACA補貼延長帶動就醫流量；四、做多巴西非相關機會，總統決選舉行前後估值有重估空間；五、對沖台灣半導體部位，因台積電調高指引後股價仍偏弱，亞洲團隊建議做空台灣半導體籃子。
對投資人而言，高盛這份周報的重點不是「AI結束」，而是定價階段切換：股價還在講成長，債市已開始算折舊與融資成本。若信貸利差續擴，AI概念股補跌風險將從邊緣租戶、NeoCloud、光通訊與記憶體鏈，逐步回推至核心雲巨頭與半導體龍頭。
paras_en: The pricing of AI themes in U.S. equities and credit markets is showing a clear split. Goldman Sachs' latest research note says credit spreads for AI hyperscale cloud providers have widened to the widest level this year, yet stock prices have not yet fully reflected the pressure.
Goldman strategist Louis Miller notes the market faces a binary choice: "Either the bond market is overly pessimistic, or the stock market still has about 15% downside not yet priced in."

The Goldman AI hyperscale cloud credit spread index (GSUCHS30) rose to a new high for the year last week. Miller points out that when spreads were near this level in July, the related stock prices were roughly 15% lower than current levels.

Moreover, the basket of AI beneficiary stocks relative to the S&P 500 "excluding AI components" has fallen about 25% from its June peak. Credit markets, which are more sensitive to cash flow, financing costs and default risk, reacted first, indicating the debate has shifted from "how strong AI demand is" to "whether capital spending can be recouped."

The pressure isn’t limited to cloud providers. Credit default swaps on hyperscale cloud firms hit historic highs, and in the junk bond market, 7 of 20 AI data‑center bonds rely on a single tenant, CoreWeave, whose bond yields have surged to roughly 15% and entered distressed territory. Goldman sees this as a signal that AI financing is spreading from the core to the periphery.

The core issue is a peak in capital‑expenditure growth. Goldman estimates hyperscale cloud cap‑ex annual growth will top out in Q3 this year at about 116%, then slow each quarter, falling to roughly 20% by the end of 2027. The focus isn’t an immediate drop in total spend, but the market’s valuation built on a "continuous acceleration" narrative, which must be re‑calculated once growth flattens.

At the same time, depreciation backlash is the next hidden bomb. Goldman calculates that after subtracting depreciation, the net contribution of hyperscale cloud cap‑ex to S&P EPS growth will be about +11 percentage points in 2026, drop to +7 points in 2027, and turn negative (‑1 point) in 2028 as massive data‑center assets hit peak amortization, turning what once supported high AI profits into a profit‑and‑loss drag.

Internal market indicators are also weakening. Put‑option volume rose to the second‑highest level of the year last Friday (the 16th); Goldman’s high‑beta factor portfolio is down 15% from its peak; cyclical stocks’ implied growth expectations relative to defensive stocks have fallen to about 2%; hedge‑fund beta‑adjusted net positions sit at the 67th percentile of the past five years and net leverage at the 17th percentile, showing a desire to ride the AI wave without sufficient leverage. Financial conditions have turned negative, with higher rates and wider spreads directly squeezing debt‑heavy stocks.

However, Miller does not predict a full index collapse. He says the market is rotating to absorb pressure and outlines five strategies: 1) go long the broad market excluding AI, as AI‑related and non‑AI assets are now negatively correlated; 2) go long quality factors while avoiding an overheated tech side—quality factors have risen 20% in three months and RSI has broken 80; 3) mid‑term healthcare, betting on extended ACA subsidies driving patient volume; 4) go long Brazil’s non‑correlated opportunities, where valuation could be reset around the presidential election; 5) hedge Taiwan semiconductor exposure, as TSMC’s stock remains weak despite raised guidance, with the Asian team recommending shorting a Taiwan semiconductor basket.

For investors, the key takeaway from Goldman’s weekly note isn’t that "AI is over," but that the pricing phase is shifting: stocks are still talking growth, while the bond market is already pricing depreciation and financing costs. If credit spreads keep widening, the risk of further AI‑related stock pull‑backs will move from edge tenants, NeoCloud, optical‑communication and memory chains back toward core cloud giants and semiconductor leaders.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：Meta及特斯拉財報、AI漲勢動搖、Fed升息預期
paras: 隨著引領市場的AI交易近期遭遇挫折，華爾街本週將聚焦Meta Platforms(META-US)等重要企業即將公布的財報，市場也將藉此檢驗投資人對這波漲勢的信心。
AI概念股票是這波美股多頭行情的核心，而這波行情才剛迎來四週年。然而，相關類股近幾日表現疲弱，半導體公司及戴爾科技(DELL-US)等科技硬體企業股價大幅下跌。
Meta是大舉投資AI資料中心建設的超大規模雲端服務商之一，將成為這週財報季焦點之一。此外，半導體設備商科林研發(LRCX-US)、德州儀器(TXN-US)，以及馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉 (TSLA-US)也將公布財報。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions投資組合策略師Garrett Melson表示，「市場目前的氛圍確實有些不安。顯然AI目前的發展方向仍存在許多不確定性。」
市場近期開始擔憂AI基礎建設熱潮的融資風險。這波投資熱潮推升了許多企業的獲利，也帶動經濟成長。投資人密切關注AI雲端公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US)最新發展，該公司負債約500億美元，上週股價重挫。
其他謹慎訊號還包括，德銀與加拿大皇家銀行資本市場策略師近期分別下調對科技類股的看好程度。德銀策略師10月9日表示，資金輪動至科技股的行情「已經走得太遠，短期內的風險報酬前景不再有利」。
受到大型科技股與AI類股大幅下跌拖累，標普500指數上週創6月以來最大單週跌幅。不過，該指數距離本月創下的歷史高點仍僅約2%。相較之下，上個月因科技股強勢而落後的其他類股表現穩健，醫療保健與民生必需品類股均有所上漲。
Melson表示，「這確實是一個行情開關不斷切換的市場。當AI類股表現強勢時，就會吸走其他所有類股的市場關注度。」

Meta打頭陣 大型雲端業者財報登場

美股財報季熱度升溫，投資人期待企業交出強勁成績。根據LSEG IBES，標普500成分股企業第三季獲利預計年增逾30%。
AI資料中心與基礎設施的大規模支出，是推動獲利成長的重要因素。高盛估計，Meta在內的五家AI超大規模雲端服務商，明年資本支出合計預計將增至約1.2兆美元。投資人正急於尋找訊號，確認這些企業能從相關投資中獲得回報，以建立對這種支出模式可持續性的信心。
紐約梅隆銀行股票分析師Kevin Shea表示，「財報季最重要的觀察重點之一，是超大規模雲端服務商的獲利成長速度，能否超越資本支出的成長速度。」
Meta市值約1.8兆美元，近期隨著公司推出Muse AI助理，股價有所上漲。
Horizon Investment Services執行長Chuck Carlson表示，「隨著資金成本上升，這種大幅擴張的資本支出將變得更加昂貴，也進一步提高了投資報酬的門檻。Meta將率先公布財報，市場也將期待公司對這個問題提供更多說明。」

半導體廠、特斯拉接力公布財報

晶片公司一直是這波資本支出熱潮最大受益者之一，但相關股票近期漲勢已經降溫。費城半導體指數本月下跌約12%，儘管如此，今年以來仍上漲57%，遠高於標普500指數約12%的年初至今漲幅。
科林研發與德州儀器週三公布的財報，可能為半導體產業的整體需求提供更廣泛訊號。科林研發今年以來股價上漲54%，德州儀器則上漲59%。
投資人也將關注馬斯克旗下兩家市值遠超過1兆美元的企業財報：同時經營AI業務的太空公司SpaceX，以及作為科技股帶動美股多頭行情代表之一的特斯拉。
其他本週將公布財報的重要企業，還包括串流媒體公司Netflix(NFLX-US)、消費用品公司寶僑(PG-US)，以及航空引擎製造商GE Aerospace(GE-US)。

聯準會10月升息預期降溫

美國公債殖利率上升，以及聯準會(Fed)可能進一步升息的前景，也仍是投資人關注焦點。
上週公布的高於預期的通膨數據，一度提高了市場對聯準會在10月底會議再次升息的押注。不過，期貨價格顯示，多數投資人仍預期美國央行將等到12月會議，才進行今年第二次升息。
瑞銀全球財富管理分析師週四在報告中表示，「如果本次財報季表現同樣強勁，將有助於股市抵禦利率溫和上升帶來的壓力。」
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。

items.title: 優分析｜美股觀察：AI投資疑慮升溫、那斯達克週跌4.5%Meta、特斯拉與SpaceX將公布財報
items.title_en: Analysis｜US Stock Watch: AI Investment Concerns Rise, Nasdaq Down 4.5% This Week, Meta, Tesla and SpaceX to Report Earnings
paras: 2026年10月18日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國股市過去一週出現明顯的風險偏好轉變，人工智慧（AI）相關股票遭遇大規模賣壓，那斯達克綜合指數單週重挫4.5%，標普500指數下跌1.95%，小型股羅素2000指數下跌3.05%。相較之下，道瓊工業指數在能源、醫療及民生消費類股支撐下，逆勢上漲0.7%。市場資金從高成長科技股轉向防禦型產業，反映投資人對AI需求、資本支出及融資能力的疑慮正在升高。
標普500指數與那斯達克綜合指數雙雙跌破50日移動平均線，羅素2000指數則跌破200日均線。主要指數接連跌破重要支撐，也讓市場關注焦點從先前的AI成長潛力，逐漸轉向企業是否具備足夠的獲利能力與現金流，支撐持續擴大的投資規模。

這波賣壓以AI基礎建設與科技軟體類股最為明顯。AI雲端運算服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US)單週暴跌25%，戴爾科技Dell Technologies(DELL-US)下跌23%，記憶體大廠美光科技Micron Technology(MU-US)下跌近15%。其中，CoreWeave債務壓力受到市場關注，加上AI公司Anthropic營收表現未達市場期待，使投資人開始重新評估AI運算需求的成長速度，以及相關企業能否持續取得擴張所需資金。
值得注意的是，這次修正並不只集中在AI伺服器與半導體供應鏈。原本表現相對強勢的企業軟體及網路安全類股也同步走弱，CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)與Snowflake(SNOW-US)單週下跌17%，Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)及Cloudflare(NET-US)跌幅則達18%。
追蹤軟體產業的iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF單週下跌7.4%，VanEck半導體ETF跌幅更達10.5%，顯示市場對科技股的風險評價已出現全面調整。
這也反映AI產業目前面臨的關鍵問題，已不只是技術發展速度，而是龐大資本支出能否持續轉化為實際營收與獲利。過去市場普遍將大型科技企業擴建資料中心、採購AI晶片與伺服器視為產業成長的重要動能，但隨著投資金額持續攀升，投資人開始更加重視AI服務的商業化進展，以及企業投入資金後的回收能力。
尤其AI產業鏈的需求具有高度連動性。大型科技公司增加資本支出，會直接帶動AI加速器、伺服器、記憶體、網路設備與資料中心基礎建設訂單；反過來說，一旦主要客戶調降擴產計畫，影響也可能沿著供應鏈向上游傳遞。因此，AI相關股票近期同步下跌，除了反映市場估值修正，也顯示投資人擔心未來設備採購與產能擴張速度可能不如原先預期。
接下來一週的企業財報，將成為檢驗AI投資信心的重要關鍵。Meta Platforms(META-US)與特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)將於美東時間10月21日盤後公布財報，SpaceX則預計於10月20日公布業績。市場除了關注營收與獲利表現，更將聚焦管理層對2027年資本支出的規劃。
其中，Meta的資本支出展望尤其重要。作為AI基礎建設的重要投資企業，Meta對資料中心、AI運算設備及相關基礎設施的投資態度，將影響市場對後續AI設備需求的預期。如果公司持續上調或維持高水準的2027年資本支出計畫，並提供足夠的需求與營運成長依據，將有助於緩解市場對AI投資放緩的疑慮。
不過，高資本支出本身並不必然代表利多。當市場已開始擔憂AI投資回報與融資壓力時，企業除了公布投資金額，更需要說明資金來源、設備利用率及未來營收成長如何支撐這些支出。若資本支出持續增加，但AI業務的營收貢獻與現金流改善速度未能同步提升，市場仍可能對企業估值採取更保守的態度。
特斯拉與SpaceX的財報也具有類似的意義。兩家公司正投入大量資金推動相關技術與基礎建設，市場預期兩者本季仍可能因投資支出而出現現金消耗，即使SpaceX有機會首次公布調整後利潤，現金流狀況仍是重要觀察指標。此外，市場也將關注特斯拉執行長馬斯克是否進一步透露兩家公司潛在整合的可能性。
除了AI投資疑慮，美國債券及能源市場的變化，也增加科技股短期走勢的不確定性。上週美國10年期公債殖利率下跌近15個基點，下降至5.1%，從週中一度超過5.3%的高點回落。一般而言，公債殖利率下降有助於降低成長型企業未來現金流的折現壓力，但這次科技股卻同步重挫，顯示殖利率下跌並未轉化為市場對成長股的樂觀情緒，反而可能反映投資人對AI投資週期的疑慮。
與此同時，美國原油期貨單週大漲10.4%，收在每桶101.41美元，重新站上100美元關卡。油價上漲可能增加企業能源、物流及資料中心營運成本，也可能推升通膨壓力。如果後續AI財報改善市場信心，帶動公債殖利率反彈，高利率與能源成本上升也對科技股估值形成壓力。
資金流向已反映市場對不同產業的重新評價。上週能源類股ETF上漲4.9%，醫療保健類股ETF上漲3.45%，金融類股ETF上漲1.4%；相較之下，ARK Innovation ETF下跌8.9%，顯示資金正從高估值、高成長產業轉向獲利能見度較高，或受惠於能源價格上漲的領域。
由於主要指數已跌破關鍵支撐，財報中任何涉及AI資本支出、訂單需求或現金流的訊息，都可能放大市場波動，而財報公布後的企業展望，也將比單季獲利是否優於預期更具參考價值。

paras_en: October 18, 2026 (Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – US equities showed a clear shift in risk appetite over the past week, with AI‑related stocks hit by massive selling pressure. The Nasdaq Composite fell 4.5% for the week, the S&P 500 dropped 1.95%, and the Russell 2000 slipped 3.05%. By contrast, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.7% on the back of energy, health‑care and consumer‑discretionary stocks. Capital moved from high‑growth tech to defensive sectors, reflecting growing investor doubts about AI demand, capital spending and financing capacity.

Both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite broke below their 50‑day moving averages, while the Russell 2000 fell beneath its 200‑day average. The breach of these key support levels shifted market focus from AI growth potential to whether companies have sufficient profitability and cash flow to sustain expanding investment scales.

The sell‑off was most pronounced in AI infrastructure and software stocks. AI cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) plunged 25% for the week, Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) fell 23%, and memory giant Micron Technology (MU‑US) dropped nearly 15%. CoreWeave’s debt burden drew market attention, and weaker‑than‑expected revenue from AI firm Anthropic prompted investors to reassess the growth rate of AI compute demand and the ability of related firms to secure funding for expansion.

Notably, the correction was not limited to AI servers and semiconductor supply chains. Previously resilient enterprise‑software and cybersecurity stocks also weakened, with CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) and Snowflake (SNOW‑US) each down 17% for the week, while Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) and Cloudflare (NET‑US) fell about 18%.

The iShares Expanded Tech‑Software Sector ETF, which tracks the software industry, slid 7.4% for the week, and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF fell 10.5%, indicating a broad‑based re‑rating of tech‑stock risk.

This underscores the core issue facing the AI sector: it is no longer just the speed of technological development, but whether massive capital outlays can be turned into real revenue and profit. In the past, the market treated large‑cap tech firms’ data‑center expansions, AI‑chip purchases and server builds as key growth drivers, but as spending climbs, investors are paying more attention to the commercialization of AI services and the ability of companies to recoup their investments.

The AI value chain is highly inter‑linked. When big tech ramps up capex, it directly fuels orders for AI accelerators, servers, memory, networking gear and data‑center infrastructure; conversely, if major customers scale back expansion plans, the impact can ripple upstream through the supply chain. Hence the recent synchronized decline in AI‑related stocks reflects both a valuation correction and investor worries that future equipment purchases and capacity growth may fall short of expectations.

The upcoming week of corporate earnings will be a crucial test of confidence in AI investments. Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US) will release earnings after market close on October 21 Eastern Time, and SpaceX is slated to report results on October 20. Beyond revenue and profit, the market will focus on management’s 2027 capital‑expenditure plans.

Meta’s capex outlook is especially significant. As a major investor in AI infrastructure, Meta’s spending on data centers, AI compute equipment and related facilities will shape market expectations for downstream AI equipment demand. If the company maintains or raises a high‑level 2027 capex plan and backs it with solid demand and operating growth, it could ease concerns about a slowdown in AI investment.

However, high capex does not automatically translate into a bullish signal. With the market already questioning AI investment returns and financing pressures, companies need to explain not only the amount they will spend but also the funding sources, equipment utilization rates and how future revenue growth will support those outlays. If capex continues to rise while AI‑related revenue contribution and cash‑flow improvements lag, valuations may remain under pressure.

Tesla’s and SpaceX’s earnings carry similar implications. Both firms are pouring substantial funds into related technologies and infrastructure, and investors expect cash consumption this quarter despite potential upside. Even if SpaceX reports adjusted profit for the first time, cash‑flow health will be closely watched. The market will also watch whether Tesla CEO Elon Musk hints at deeper integration between the two companies.

Beyond AI‑investment doubts, shifts in US bond and energy markets add short‑term uncertainty to tech‑stock performance. Last week the US 10‑year Treasury yield fell nearly 15 basis points to 5.1%, retreating from a mid‑week peak above 5.3%. Typically, lower yields reduce discount pressure on future cash flows for growth firms, but the simultaneous tech‑stock plunge suggests the yield drop did not translate into optimism for growth stocks and may reflect lingering concerns about the AI investment cycle.

At the same time, US crude oil futures surged 10.4% for the week, closing at $101.41 per barrel and reclaiming the $100 level. Higher oil prices could raise energy, logistics and data‑center operating costs and add inflationary pressure. If subsequent AI earnings revive market confidence and push Treasury yields higher, the combination of higher rates and energy costs could weigh on tech‑stock valuations.

Capital flows already show a re‑rating across sectors. Last week energy‑sector ETFs rose 4.9%, health‑care ETFs gained 3.45%, and financial ETFs climbed 1.4%, while the ARK Innovation ETF fell 8.9%, indicating money moving from high‑valuation, high‑growth areas toward sectors with clearer profit visibility or benefiting from higher energy prices.

Because major indices have broken key support levels, any earnings‑release commentary on AI capex, order demand or cash flow could amplify market moves. Post‑earnings outlooks will likely be more informative than whether a single quarter’s profit beats estimates.
