items.title: 美股繁榮是假象？AI泡沫疑慮升溫 標普500恐面臨30%修正
items.title_en: Is US Stock Market Prosperity an Illusion? AI Bubble Concerns Rise, S&P 500 May Face a 30% Correction
paras: 標普500指數10月中旬仍徘徊在7,600點上方高位區間，那斯達克與科技巨頭繼續主導市場敘事。表面繁榮之下，市場內部結構已出現深刻分化。前雷曼兄弟交易員、Bear Traps Report創辦人Larry McDonald提出的核心判斷——指數層面尚未充分反映的「內部崩盤」、被動投資的暗面、AI資本開支的不可持續性，以及硬資產與長久期債券的相對吸引力——在最新市場數據中得到部分印證，也引發對未來一至三年資產配置邏輯的重新審視。
當前市場最顯著的結構特徵是市值加權指數與多數成分股表現的嚴重背離。標普500中科技板塊權重長期接近或超過50%，前兩大權重股（輝達與蘋果）合計佔比一度接近13%。同時，大量知名品牌——Nike、麥當勞、家得寶、哈雷戴維森等消費與工業標的——自高點回落30%至80%。2026年10月中旬的市場數據繼續顯示，那斯達克與半導體板塊出現明顯調整，而指數整體仍維持相對韌性。

這種背離並非偶然。被動資金持續流入迫使指數基金與ETF不斷買入權重最大的少數股票，形成自我強化循環。當市場處於上漲年份且指數漲幅達到兩位數時，年末稅務損失賣出與機構調倉往往進一步加劇「強者恆強、弱者更弱」的格局。結果是：指數創下或接近歷史高位，而更廣泛的經濟與企業基本面卻已承壓。消費者層面，油價與中長期利率的顯著上行已構成實際購買力衝擊，連鎖消費與耐用品企業的業績與估值同步承壓，正是這一內部壓力的直接體現。
從歷史比較看，2000年科技泡沫與2007年金融危機前均出現過類似「指數掩蓋內部裂痕」的現象。當時權重集中度遠低於今日，而今日被動資金體量與算法交易的放大效應，使集中度風險更加突出。一旦權重股出現同步調整，指數層面的回撤可能遠超多數投資者的預期。
AI主題仍是驅動科技巨頭與指數的核心敘事，但資本開支的規模與回報週期已引發越來越多的質疑。超大規模科技公司與「新雲端」資料中心運營商持續大規模舉債與股權融資，用於算力、電力與土地投入。2026年下半年，部分資料中心相關債券與可轉債出現明顯拋售，CoreWeave等標的股價與信用利差同步惡化，被視為早期警示信號。

更深層的問題在於估值與退出機制。Anthropic、OpenAI等公司的估值從數年前的千億級躍升至數萬億級，一旦通過IPO或二級市場退出，零售與401(k)資金將在一定程度上成為接盤方。這與2000年前後科技股IPO潮存在結構性相似：早期投資者鎖定利潤，而後期進入者承擔更高估值風險。同時，AI相關資本開支對當期自由現金流形成顯著擠壓，部分巨頭從高自由現金流狀態轉向中性甚至負值，進一步放大了市場對「回報何時兌現」的疑慮。
輝達(NVDA-US)作為算力核心受益者，其估值與市值對指數影響巨大。晶片迭代加速、競爭加劇與客戶資本開支可能放緩，使未來兩到三年出現顯著估值回歸的概率上升。若這一情景兌現，指數層面30%級別的調整並非不可想象，而此後可能進入類似2000至2010年的長時間橫盤整理。
與股票市場形成鮮明對比的是債券市場的深度調整。2017至2021年超低利率環境下發行的大量長期公司債，在利率中樞顯著抬升後價格大幅下跌。以蘋果為例，部分低票息長期債券交易價格曾一度接近面值的一半。這類債券在利率回落情景下具備可觀的資本利得空間，疊加票息後的年化回報有望接近甚至超過部分股票的長期預期收益。
銀行業層面，商業地產貸款再融資壓力與低息存款流失風險並存。零利率時代積累的低成本存款在貨幣市場基金與穩定幣競爭下面臨流出壓力，進一步壓縮淨息差。歐洲銀行對主權債敞口的波動也提示全球固定收益市場的聯動風險。若長端利率出現階段性衝高後的反轉，長久期優質債券與國債有望成為重要的避險與收益來源。
長期來看，更高的通膨中樞與利率環境有利於控制實物資產的企業。1968至1981年高通膨與高利率週期中，工業、材料與能源在標普500中的權重曾達到約50%。當前這些板塊合計權重僅十餘個百分點。家庭財富中配置於商品與相關股票的比例也遠低於歷史高點。
銅、天然氣、石油服務與礦業公司不僅受益於AI資料中心與全球電力基礎設施建設，也受益於新興市場（尤其是印度）的能源與空調需求增長。即便AI資本開支出現階段性放緩，財富從高估值成長股向低估值硬資產的再配置本身就能提供支撐。自由現金流收益率較高、且持續回購的能源與材料公司，在風險回報比上往往優於高估值科技股。
黃金與白銀的表現進一步印證了這一邏輯。中央銀行持續購金、地緣政治不確定性與對主權信用的長期擔憂，使黃金在2026年維持高位運行。穩定幣規模已達約3,000億美元量級，其底層資產大量配置短期國債，客觀上增加了對美元短期債務的需求，卻也強化了金融壓抑與硬資產配置的吸引力。
美國聯邦債務規模龐大，單純依靠傳統手段難以持續。穩定幣的擴張、潛在的收益率曲線控制工具，以及黃金儲備的會計重估等「工具箱」選項，均指向某種形式的金融壓抑——通過機制設計壓低實際利率、引導資金進入特定資產。戰後初期聯準會與財政部的緊密協作提供了歷史參照。這類政策若落地，將進一步推動資金從純金融資產向硬資產與實物資產轉移。
同時，政治週期與中期選舉前後的政策不確定性，也可能成為市場波動的催化劑。無論是對AI資本開支的監管壓力，還是對財政可持續性的重新定價，都可能加速當前高度集中的市場結構發生調整。
在高度集中的市場環境下，單純持有市值加權指數已難以提供充分分散。等權重指數、主動構建的硬資產傾斜組合、精選長久期優質債券，以及具備資料護城河的細分AI應用領域（如醫療機器人、油氣服務資料平台），構成更具韌性的配置方向。稅務損失賣出後的反彈窗口、被過度拋售的優質品牌，也提供了階段性機會。
風險提示同樣明確：AI主題的調整若引發連鎖反應，可能短暫拖累硬資產需求預期；利率若繼續超預期上行，將加劇銀行業與消費端壓力；政策干預的力度與時點存在高度不確定性。投資者需在承認集中度風險的同時，避免簡單的全面做空，而應聚焦估值與現金流的相對優勢。
市場從不會以線性方式兌現風險。當前指數高位與內部裂痕並存的格局，更接近2000年前後的結構特徵，而非單一泡沫的簡單重演。被動投資的規模效應放大了權重股的影響力，也延緩了調整的全面展開。真正的風險不在於是否調整，而在於調整時投資者是否已提前完成從「指數跟隨」向「結構區分」的轉變。硬資產、現金流與合理估值，將成為下一階段更具確定性的錨點。
paras_en: The S&P 500 was still hovering above the 7,600‑point high‑range in mid‑October, while the Nasdaq and tech giants continued to dominate market narrative. Beneath the surface prosperity, the market’s internal structure has become sharply divided. Former Lehman trader and Bear Traps Report founder Larry McDonald’s core thesis – an “internal collapse” not yet reflected at the index level, the dark side of passive investing, the unsustainability of AI capital spending, and the relative appeal of hard assets and long‑duration bonds – finds partial confirmation in the latest data and prompts a reassessment of asset‑allocation logic for the next one to three years.

The most striking structural feature today is the severe divergence between the market‑cap‑weighted index and the performance of most constituents. The tech sector’s weight in the S&P 500 has long been near or above 50%, with the two largest holdings (Nvidia and Apple) at one point approaching 13% combined. At the same time, many well‑known consumer and industrial brands – Nike, McDonald’s, Home Depot, Harley‑Davidson and others – have fallen 30% to 80% from their peaks. Mid‑October 2026 data still show a clear pullback in the Nasdaq and semiconductor sector, while the overall index remains relatively resilient.

This divergence is not accidental. Ongoing inflows into passive funds force index funds and ETFs to keep buying the few highest‑weight stocks, creating a self‑reinforcing loop. In years when the market rises and the index posts double‑digit gains, year‑end tax‑loss selling and institutional rebalancing further amplify a “the strong get stronger, the weak get weaker” pattern. The result: the index reaches or nears historic highs while the broader economy and corporate fundamentals are under pressure. On the consumer side, higher oil prices and rising medium‑ to long‑term rates have eroded real purchasing power, squeezing chain‑store and durable‑goods companies’ earnings and valuations – a direct manifestation of this internal strain.

Historically, similar “index‑masking‑internal‑cracks” episodes appeared before the 2000 tech bubble and the 2007 financial crisis. Back then, weight concentration was far lower than today, but today’s massive passive capital and algorithmic‑trading amplification make concentration risk even more pronounced. If the heavyweight stocks adjust in sync, the index‑level drawdown could far exceed most investors’ expectations.

The AI theme still drives tech giants and the index, but the scale of capital spending and the length of payback periods are drawing increasing skepticism. Mega‑tech firms and “new‑cloud” data‑center operators continue to raise large amounts of debt and equity to fund compute, power and land. In the second half of 2026, some data‑center‑related bonds and convertibles saw noticeable selling; stocks such as CoreWeave and their credit spreads deteriorated, being viewed as early warning signs.

A deeper issue lies in valuations and exit mechanisms. Companies like Anthropic and OpenAI have seen valuations jump from the hundred‑billion to the tens‑of‑trillions dollar range in just a few years. If they exit via IPO or secondary markets, retail and 401(k) funds will become the buyers to some extent. This mirrors the tech‑IPO wave around 2000: early investors lock in profits while later entrants shoulder higher valuation risk. At the same time, AI‑related capex is squeezing current free‑cash‑flow, pushing some giants from strong free‑cash‑flow positions to neutral or even negative, heightening doubts about when returns will materialize.

Nvidia (NVDA‑US), as the core beneficiary of compute power, has an outsized impact on valuation and market‑cap weight. Accelerating chip cycles, intensifying competition and a possible slowdown in customer capex raise the probability of a significant valuation reversion over the next two to three years. If that scenario plays out, a 30%‑level correction at the index level is not unimaginable, after which the market could enter a prolonged sideways consolidation similar to 2000‑2010.

In stark contrast to equities, the bond market has undergone a deep correction. Long‑dated corporate bonds issued in the ultra‑low‑rate environment of 2017‑2021 have seen prices plunge sharply after central rates rose markedly. For example, some low‑coupon Apple long‑term bonds traded at roughly half of par. These bonds offer substantial capital‑gain potential if rates fall, and when combined with coupon yields their annualized return could approach or even exceed the long‑term expected returns of many stocks.

In banking, commercial‑real‑estate loan refinancing pressure coexists with the risk of low‑rate deposit outflows. Low‑cost deposits accumulated in the zero‑interest era face outflows to money‑market funds and stablecoins, further compressing net interest margins. European banks’ sovereign‑debt exposure volatility also highlights global fixed‑income linkage risk. Should long‑end rates spike and then reverse, high‑quality long‑duration bonds and sovereigns could become key hedges and return sources.

Over the long run, higher inflation cores and rate environments favor companies that control physical assets. During the high‑inflation, high‑rate cycle of 1968‑1981, industrials, materials and energy together accounted for about 50% of the S&P 500. Today those sectors together make up only a little over ten percent. The share of household wealth allocated to commodities and related equities is also far below historic peaks.

Copper, natural gas, oil‑service and mining firms benefit not only from AI data‑centers and global power‑infrastructure builds but also from growing energy and air‑conditioning demand in emerging markets, especially India. Even if AI capex eases temporarily, the reallocation of wealth from over‑valued growth stocks to undervalued hard assets can provide support. Energy and materials companies with high free‑cash‑flow yields and ongoing share buybacks often offer a better risk‑adjusted return than lofty‑valued tech stocks.

Gold and silver performance further validates this logic. Central‑bank gold purchases, geopolitical uncertainty and long‑term concerns about sovereign credit have kept gold near its 2026 highs. Stablecoin assets have reached roughly $300 billion, with underlying holdings heavily weighted to short‑term Treasuries, which objectively boosts demand for short‑term US debt while also reinforcing the appeal of financial repression and hard‑asset allocation.

The sheer size of US federal debt makes reliance on traditional tools unsustainable. The expansion of stablecoins, potential yield‑curve control mechanisms and accounting re‑valuation of gold reserves constitute a “toolbox” pointing toward a form of financial repression – designing mechanisms to push real rates lower and steer capital into specific assets. The close post‑World‑War‑II coordination between the Fed and Treasury offers a historical precedent. If such policies materialize, they would further shift capital from pure financial assets toward hard and real assets.

At the same time, political cycles and policy uncertainty around mid‑term elections can act as catalysts for market volatility. Whether through regulatory pressure on AI capex or a repricing of fiscal sustainability, such factors could accelerate adjustments in today’s highly concentrated market structure.

In a highly concentrated market environment, simply holding a market‑cap‑weighted index no longer provides adequate diversification. Equal‑weight indices, actively built hard‑asset‑tilted portfolios, carefully selected long‑duration high‑quality bonds, and niche AI applications with data moats (e.g., medical robotics, oil‑and‑gas service data platforms) represent more resilient allocation paths. Post‑tax‑loss‑sale rebound windows and oversold quality brands also offer tactical opportunities.

Risk warnings are clear: an AI‑theme correction that triggers a chain reaction could briefly dampen hard‑asset demand expectations; rates rising faster than expected would heighten pressure on banks and consumers; and the scale and timing of policy intervention remain highly uncertain. Investors should acknowledge concentration risk but avoid a blanket short‑sell approach, focusing instead on relative valuation and cash‑flow advantages.

Markets never realize risk in a linear fashion. The current coexistence of high index levels and internal cracks resembles the structural features of the early‑2000s rather than a simple replay of a single bubble. The scale effect of passive investing amplifies heavyweight influence and delays a full‑blown correction. The real risk lies not in whether a correction occurs, but whether investors have already shifted from “index‑following” to “structural‑distinction” before it does. Hard assets, cash flow and sensible valuations will become the next‑stage anchors of certainty.

items.title: 川普力挺AI仍有變數！為何「德州州長選戰」被點名是資料中心發展關鍵？
items.title_en: Trump’s Support for AI Still Has Uncertainties! Why the Texas Gubernatorial Race Is Cited as Key to Data Center Development?
paras: 對關注人工智慧(AI)與資料中心面臨哪些政策阻力的投資人而言，AI產業獲得美國總統川普的力挺，代表即使民主黨在11月期中選舉中贏得眾議院與參議院多數席次，川普仍可能否決任何旨在打擊AI的民主黨法案。Evercore ISI分析師因而指出，州長選舉才是最值得關注的關鍵戰役。
Evercore分析師Matt Aks、Sarah Bianchi與Karlin Gatton周四(15日)在致客戶報告中表示，德州州長選舉「是與選舉直接相關的最大風險」。這場選戰由共和黨現任州長Greg Abbott對決民主黨候選人、德州州議員Gina Hinojosa。
分析師指出，多個州的州長選舉實際上都將資料中心暫停建設議題列為選戰焦點，但德州尤其關鍵，因為當地有大量資料中心開發計畫，而且Abbott在擔任州長任內，已實施暫時的建設禁令。
根據皮尤研究中心(Pew Research Center)，在全美各州中，無論是已營運資料中心數量或規劃中的設施數量，德州均排名第二，僅次於維吉尼亞州。維州下一次州長選舉則要等到2029年。
Evercore分析師寫道：「其他州的州長選舉，尤其是喬治亞州與俄亥俄州，也將對資料中心開發產生重要影響。無論選舉結果如何，各州議會可能仍會積極推動相關政策。」
他們接著說：「不過，我們認為德州的影響尤其重大，因為涉及的投資規模龐大，而且德州能否證明大型市場可以克服政治阻力、建立讓大部分投資得以持續推進的制度框架，也具有更廣泛的意義。」
多數民調顯示，Abbott有望贏得德州州長選舉。德州是共和黨占優勢的州，上一次選出民主黨州長是在1990年。不過，Hinojosa近期在部分民調中領先。
根據RealClearPolitics截至周四的民調移動平均值，Abbott支持率為48.6%，高於Hinojosa的46.4%。
預測市場Kalshi的數據顯示，Hinojosa周四勝選機率約為25%，本月稍早曾升至27%的新高。另一個預測市場Polymarket給出的勝選機率也相近，為23%。
Evercore團隊表示：「如果Abbott如目前預期般勝選，我們認為，隨著現行審查程序推進，未來的發展方向將更加明朗。獲得地方支持、具可信度的計畫最終應能繼續推進，但可能須遵守額外規定，德州下一個立法會期也可能出現稅制調整。」
不過，分析師警告，若民主黨候選人Hinojosa意外勝選，資料中心建設禁令可能無限期延長。
資料中心開發追蹤公司Cleanview的地圖顯示，德州已營運及規劃中的資料中心，主要集中在達拉斯、奧斯汀、聖安東尼奧及休士頓等大都會地區。
儘管本月AI交易熱潮已出現退潮跡象，AI產業今年一直是推動美國經濟與股市的重要力量，持有AI相關股票的Global X人工智慧與科技ETF(AIQ-US)今年以來上漲25%，同期標普500指數上漲13%。
paras_en: For investors concerned about AI and the policy hurdles facing data centers, the AI industry’s backing by President Donald Trump means that even if Democrats win majorities in both the House and Senate in the November midterm elections, Trump could still veto any Democratic legislation aimed at curbing AI. Evercore ISI analysts therefore note that the governor’s race is the most critical battle to watch.

Evercore analysts Matt Aks, Sarah Bianchi and Karlin Gatton wrote in a client report on Thursday the 15th that the Texas gubernatorial election "is the biggest risk directly tied to the election." The contest pits incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott against Democratic candidate and Texas state legislator Gina Hinojosa.

The analysts point out that several states have made the pause on data‑center construction a campaign issue in their governor races, but Texas is especially pivotal because it hosts a large number of data‑center development projects and Abbott has already imposed a temporary construction ban during his tenure.

According to the Pew Research Center, Texas ranks second nationwide in both the number of operating data centers and planned facilities, trailing only Virginia. Virginia’s next gubernatorial election won’t be until 2029.

Evercore analysts write: "Governor races in other states, especially Georgia and Ohio, will also have a significant impact on data‑center development. Regardless of the election outcomes, state legislatures are likely to continue pushing related policies."

They add: "We believe Texas’s impact is especially pronounced because of the massive investment scale involved, and whether Texas can demonstrate that a large market can overcome political resistance and establish a framework that allows most investments to proceed has broader implications."

Most polls show Abbott is likely to win the Texas governor’s race. Texas is a Republican‑leaning state, having last elected a Democratic governor in 1990. However, Hinojosa has recently led in some polls.
Based on RealClearPolitics’ moving average as of Thursday, Abbott’s approval stands at 48.6%, ahead of Hinojosa’s 46.4%.

Market forecasts from Kalshi indicate Hinojosa’s probability of winning on Thursday is about 25%, after peaking at a new high of 27% earlier this month. A similar probability of 23% is given by another prediction market, Polymarket.

The Evercore team says: "If Abbott wins as currently expected, we think the path forward will become clearer as the existing review process advances. Projects with local support and credible plans should ultimately be able to move forward, though they may have to comply with additional regulations, and the next Texas legislative session could also see tax adjustments."
However, analysts warn that if Democratic candidate Hinojosa pulls off an upset, the data‑center construction ban could be extended indefinitely.
Cleanview’s data‑center development map shows that Texas’s operating and planned data centers are primarily concentrated in the major metropolitan areas of Dallas, Austin, San Antonio and Houston.

Even though the AI trading frenzy has shown signs of cooling this month, the AI sector has been a major driver of the U.S. economy and stock market this year, with the Global X Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF (AIQ‑US) up 25% year‑to‑date, compared with a 13% gain in the S&P 500 over the same period.

items.title: 標普暗藏「怪獸級牛市」！避開AI燒錢股 避險基金經理看好這些產業
items.title_en: S&P Hides a "Monstrous Bull Market"! Avoid AI Money‑Burning Stocks; Hedge‑Fund Managers Favor These Industries
paras: 儘管人工智慧(AI)概念股近期遭遇沉重賣壓，標普500指數(S&P 500)表現承壓，但避險基金經理認為，美股真正的投資機會可能正悄悄浮現。Great Hill Capital創辦人兼管理合夥人Thomas Hayes預測，未來6個月，標普500指數表面之下將醞釀一波「怪獸級牛市」(Monstrous Bull Market)，而推動這波漲勢的主角，不再是科技七巨頭，而是其餘493家企業。
《MarketWatch》週四(15日)報導，Hayes近日接受David Lin Podcast 節目訪問時指出，過去數月，美股漲勢高度集中於少數AI概念股，掩蓋了其他企業的疲弱表現。隨著市場重新評估AI基礎設施投資的成本與回報，資金正逐漸從投入巨額資本支出的科技企業，轉向能夠利用AI提升生產力、擴大利潤率的公司。
Hayes 認為，未來美股可能出現一種特殊局面：標普500與那斯達克等主要指數表現平淡，但指數內部的大多數股票卻迎來強勁漲勢。
「不耀眼的493檔」將接棒 科技七巨頭恐不再主導行情
Hayes 指出，自7月底以來，標普500指數主要依靠少數AI概念股支撐，維持在歷史高點附近，但指數中的大多數成分股其實已陷入熊市，或接近熊市水準。
由於科技巨頭在市值加權指數中占有極高比重，即使其他產業開始反彈，主要指數也未必能充分反映市場內部的強勁走勢。
他預測，未來6個月，美股將出現一波由「不耀眼的493檔」(Unmagnificent 493)帶動的牛市，與過去由科技七巨頭(Magnificent Seven)主導的行情形成鮮明對比。
Hayes 強調，真正值得關注的企業，是那些能夠運用AI提高生產效率、降低成本並改善利潤率的公司，而非持續投入龐大資金建設AI基礎設施的企業。
AI記憶體熱潮恐告終
對於近期AI基礎設施相關股票的修正，Hayes 認為，AI投資熱潮中的部分大宗商品型交易已經結束，尤其是記憶體晶片等被視為AI建設熱潮「賣鏟子」受惠者的產業。
他指出，記憶體與半導體產業具有明顯的景氣循環特性，當市場供應短缺推升價格與利潤率時，廠商便會積極擴充產能，但隨著競爭者加入、供應增加，往往恰好碰上需求降溫，最終導致價格與獲利承壓。
Hayes形容，半導體與記憶體產業幾乎每隔4年就會重演相似劇情，並引用大宗商品市場的經典法則：「高價格終將治癒高價格。」
換言之，當高獲利吸引更多供應商投入市場，原本支撐產業繁榮的供需失衡便可能逐漸消失。
AI燒錢模式面臨考驗 真正贏家是技術使用者
Hayes 進一步指出，從歷史經驗來看，在重大技術革命中，投入巨額資本支出的企業往往承擔最大風險，反而是利用新技術提升效率、改善獲利能力的企業，最終成為主要受益者。
他特別質疑OpenAI與Anthropic等AI模型開發商的商業模式，認為前沿AI模型的開發成本已經失控，若要產生足夠的自由現金流來支撐目前的企業估值，將面臨極高的財務門檻。
Hayes 也以自身基金為例，指出Great Hill Capital已開始運用AI提高內部生產力，但並非完全依賴成本高昂的封閉式模型，而是採用可自行部署的開放權重模型，包括Mistral AI、阿里巴巴(BABA-US)的通義千問(Qwen)，以及Meta(META-US)的Llama。
他認為，這種模式正說明AI帶來的真正經濟價值，未必集中在模型開發商或基礎設施供應商，而可能逐漸擴散至各行各業。
點名4檔潛力股 天然氣、電信基建與物流受青睞
在具體投資標的方面，Hayes 點名天然氣生產商Comstock Resources(CRK-US)、阿里巴巴、電信基地台營運商Crown Castle(CCI-US)，以及物流與倉儲服務公司GXO Logistics(GXO-US)。
其中，Hayes 看好Comstock Resources的原因，在於該公司具備低成本天然氣生產優勢，且地理位置鄰近墨西哥灣出口終端與德州東部正在興建的高耗電資料中心，有望受惠於能源需求成長。
至於阿里巴巴，Hayes 則抱持高度樂觀態度，認為該公司透過投資布局亞洲AI新創企業，掌握廣泛的產業成長機會。
他特別提到阿里巴巴投資的月之暗面(Moonshot AI)，指出該公司可能很快以500億美元估值上市。不過，這仍屬Hayes 提出的潛在情境，並非已確認的上市計畫。
此外，Crown Castle與GXO Logistics分別涉及電信基礎設施及物流倉儲業務，也是 Hayes 看好的投資方向。
資金轉向醫療、公用事業與民生消費 防禦型類股開始崛起
除了個別企業，Hayes 也觀察到，美股資金輪動已經開始，投資人正逐漸降低對科技七巨頭與AI概念股的依賴，轉向其他產業尋找投資機會。
他指出，醫療保健、公用事業及民生必需品等傳統防禦型產業，近期開始獲得資金青睞，而住宅建商等對利率敏感的企業，也逐漸出現相對強勢表現。
這項變化反映投資人不再單純追逐AI題材，而是重新重視企業估值、獲利品質與現金流。
Hayes認為，隨著市場重新評估科技股的資本支出壓力，資金有望進一步流向過去遭到忽視、但基本面相對穩健的產業。
美債殖利率逾5% 股票吸引力面臨挑戰
Hayes 也指出，債券市場重新具備吸引力，是推動美股資金輪動的另一項重要因素。
他認為，當美國10年期公債殖利率達到5.30%時，相較於股票約5%、且不具保證的預期收益率，債券提供的報酬更具吸引力。
不過，美國公債若持有至到期，可依約取得票息與本金，但持有期間仍存在價格波動風險，因此不能將殖利率直接視為完全無風險的總報酬。
paras_en: Despite recent heavy selling pressure on AI concept stocks and a strained performance of the S&P 500, hedge‑fund managers believe that the real investment opportunity in U.S. equities may be quietly emerging. Thomas Hayes, founder and managing partner of Great Hill Capital, predicts that within the next six months a "Monstrous Bull Market" will brew beneath the surface of the S&P 500, driven not by the seven tech giants but by the remaining 493 companies.

MarketWatch reported on Thursday the 15th that Hayes, in a recent interview on the David Lin Podcast, said the recent rally in U.S. stocks has been highly concentrated in a few AI concept stocks, masking the weak performance of other firms. As the market re‑evaluates the cost and return of AI infrastructure investment, capital is gradually shifting from tech companies with massive capex to firms that can use AI to boost productivity and expand profit margins.
Hayes believes a special situation may develop in U.S. equities: major indices such as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq could look flat, while most stocks inside the indices experience strong gains.
The "unremarkable 493" will take over; the seven tech giants may no longer dominate the market

Hayes notes that since the end of July the S&P 500 has been propped up mainly by a handful of AI concept stocks, keeping the index near historic highs, while most of its component stocks are actually in a bear market or close to bear‑market levels.
Because the tech giants carry a huge weight in market‑cap‑weighted indices, even if other sectors start to rebound the headline indices may not fully reflect the internal strength of the market.
He forecasts that over the next six months a bull market driven by the "unremarkable 493" will emerge, contrasting sharply with the previous rallies led by the Magnificent Seven tech giants.

Hayes stresses that the truly worth‑watching companies are those that can apply AI to raise production efficiency, cut costs and improve profit margins, rather than firms that keep pouring massive money into building AI infrastructure.
AI memory‑chip hype may be ending

Regarding the recent correction in AI infrastructure‑related stocks, Hayes believes that part of the AI investment frenzy—especially commodity‑type trades such as memory chips that have benefited as "shovel‑sell" winners of the AI build‑out—has run its course.

He points out that memory and semiconductor industries have clear cyclical patterns: when supply shortages push up prices and margins, manufacturers expand capacity, but as competitors enter and supply rises, demand cools, eventually squeezing prices and profits.
Hayes likens the semiconductor and memory sectors to a four‑year cycle that repeats, quoting the classic commodity rule: "High prices eventually cure high prices."
In other words, when high profitability attracts more suppliers, the supply‑demand imbalance that once fueled industry boom can gradually disappear.
AI’s money‑burning model faces a test; the real winners are technology users

Hayes adds that historically, in major technological revolutions, firms that pour huge capital into the new tech bear the greatest risk, while those that use the technology to improve efficiency and profitability end up as the primary beneficiaries.

He specifically questions the business models of AI model developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic, arguing that the cost of developing cutting‑edge AI models has spiraled out of control and that generating enough free cash flow to justify current valuations would require an extremely high financial hurdle.

Hayes also cites his own fund, noting that Great Hill Capital has begun using AI to boost internal productivity, but not by relying on costly closed‑source models; instead it deploys open‑weight models it can run itself, including Mistral AI, Alibaba’s (BABA‑US) Qwen, and Meta’s (META‑US) Llama.
He believes this approach shows that the true economic value of AI may not be concentrated in model developers or infrastructure providers, but could spread across many industries.
Naming four potential winners: natural gas, telecom infrastructure and logistics are favored

In terms of specific investment targets, Hayes names natural‑gas producer Comstock Resources (CRK‑US), Alibaba, telecom tower operator Crown Castle (CCI‑US), and logistics and warehousing firm GXO Logistics (GXO‑US).

Hayes likes Comstock Resources because it enjoys low‑cost natural‑gas production and is located near Gulf of Mexico export terminals and a high‑power‑consumption data‑center under construction in East Texas, positioning it to benefit from growing energy demand.
Regarding Alibaba, Hayes is highly optimistic, seeing the company’s investments in Asian AI startups as giving it broad exposure to industry growth opportunities.

He specifically mentions Alibaba’s Moonshot AI venture, noting that it could soon go public with a $50 billion valuation, though this remains a speculative scenario proposed by Hayes, not a confirmed IPO plan.
He also points out that Crown Castle and GXO Logistics, which operate telecom infrastructure and logistics‑warehouse services respectively, are among the sectors Hayes favors.
Capital is rotating toward healthcare, utilities and consumer staples; defensive stocks are on the rise

Beyond individual companies, Hayes observes that capital flows in U.S. equities have already begun to rotate, with investors gradually reducing reliance on the seven tech giants and AI concept stocks and turning to other sectors for opportunities.

He notes that traditional defensive industries such as healthcare, utilities and consumer staples have recently attracted capital, while interest‑rate‑sensitive firms like homebuilders are also showing relative strength.
This shift reflects investors moving away from a pure AI chase and re‑emphasizing company valuations, profit quality and cash flow.
Hayes believes that as the market reassesses the capital‑expenditure pressure on tech stocks, funds are likely to flow further into previously overlooked but fundamentally sound sectors.
U.S. Treasury yields above 5% challenge stock attractiveness
Hayes also points out that the renewed appeal of the bond market is another key driver of the U.S. equity capital rotation.
He argues that when the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield reaches 5.30%, its return—about 5% and without guaranteed expectations—looks more attractive than the uncertain returns from stocks.

However, while U.S. Treasuries held to maturity deliver coupon and principal as promised, they still carry price‑fluctuation risk during the holding period, so yields cannot be treated as a completely risk‑free total return.

items.title: 美銀預測Fed 10月再升息！通膨升溫添變數
items.title_en: BofA Forecasts Another Fed Rate Hike in October as Inflation Heat Up
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，美國銀行(BofA)表示，9月通膨數據意外升溫，進一步強化聯準會(Fed)在10月再次升息的理由。相較於華爾街其他機構及聯準會官員近期相對謹慎的態度，美銀的看法顯得更為急迫。
9月通膨報告再次震撼投資人，也讓聯準會的利率前景更加複雜。
美國消費者物價(CPI)較去年同期上漲3.7%，高於8月的3.4%。扣除食品與能源價格的核心通膨率則達到2.6%。兩項數據都仍高於聯準會2%的通膨目標，不過，聯準會正式衡量通膨時，採用的是個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數。
這足以讓美銀維持原先預測，即使已有不少投資人開始不再看好這項預測。
由Stephen Juneau領軍的美銀分析師團隊重申，由於通膨壓力再度升高，聯準會可能在10月升息。
市場迅速做出反應。截至10月14日，通膨報告公布前，交易員預估聯準會10月升息的隱含機率約為22%。報告公布後，這項機率已升至約47%。
而這次通膨意外升溫，並不只是汽油價格上漲所造成。
美銀真正擔憂的是，9月的價格漲勢同時擴散至商品與服務，使聯準會繼續等待的理由愈來愈難成立。
美銀先前認為，8月通膨意外升溫的情況，大多集中在特定產業，例如無線通訊服務、機票及飯店住宿。
但9月的情況有所不同。美銀指出，價格上漲已擴散至商品與服務，使聯準會更難將這波通膨視為暫時現象而置之不理。
能源價格是最明顯來源。9月CPI中的能源指數大漲5.2%，汽油價格更上漲9.1%。美銀也將機票及租車價格上漲，與伊朗衝突後能源價格走高連結起來。
然而，更令人意外的推手是AI。美銀表示，資料中心需求正外溢至部分使用相同零組件的消費性科技產品。9月資訊科技商品價格上漲0.9%，使當月核心 CPI 增加約0.02個百分點。
高盛也發現 AI 帶來的通膨效應。據《MarketWatch》報導，高盛估計，AI 熱潮使年度核心PCE通膨率增加約0.45個百分點。不過，高盛預期這項影響到了2027年將逐漸減弱。
房市則是另一項複雜因素。9月屋主等價租金（Owners’ Equivalent Rent）上漲0.35%，高於8月的0.19%。美銀並未預測租金將再次大幅飆升，而是認為，先前居住成本通膨放緩的趨勢，大致已經走到尾聲。
綜合上述壓力，美銀將9月核心 PCE 通膨的追蹤估值，從月增0.22%上調至0.32%。
美銀預測10月升息、花旗估12月 Fed官員則籲耐心
儘管美銀認為聯準會即將面臨艱難抉擇，但華爾街並非所有機構都抱持如此急迫的看法。
花旗(Citi)在9月通膨數據高於預期後，調整了利率預測，目前預期聯準會將於12月升息1碼，接著從2027年6月開始降息。
此外，瑞銀(UBS)預測聯準會將在12月及2027年3月分別升息，摩根士丹利的經濟學家也持相同看法。摩根大通財富管理則預期，聯準會還會再升息共0.5個百分點，但升息時間仍存在較大不確定性。
聯準會官員的發言，則提供了另一個保持謹慎的理由。舊金山聯準銀行總裁戴莉（Mary Daly）表示，聯準會沒有迫切需要在10月採取行動，暗示決策官員仍有時間評估接下來公布的經濟數據。
投資人接下來將密切關注通膨與就業數據、能源價格，以及美國公債殖利率的變化，以研判聯準會在10月會議上的決策。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that Bank of America (BofA) says September inflation data unexpectedly rose, further strengthening the case for the Federal Reserve to hike rates again in October. Compared with the more cautious stance of other Wall Street firms and Fed officials, BofA’s view appears more urgent.
The September inflation report shocked investors again and made the Fed’s rate outlook even more complicated.

U.S. consumer price index (CPI) rose 3.7% year‑over‑year, up from 3.4% in August. The core inflation rate, which strips out food and energy, was 2.6%. Both figures remain above the Fed’s 2% inflation target, although the Fed officially measures inflation with the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index.
This is enough for BofA to stick with its original forecast, even though many investors have begun to doubt it.
Led by Stephen Juneau, BofA’s analyst team reiterated that renewed inflation pressure could prompt the Fed to raise rates in October.

The market reacted quickly. As of October 14, before the inflation report, traders estimated the implied probability of an October hike at about 22%. After the report, that probability rose to roughly 47%.
This surprise inflation surge was not driven solely by higher gasoline prices.
BofA’s real concern is that September’s price gains spread across both goods and services, making it increasingly hard for the Fed to justify waiting.
BofA previously thought the August inflation surprise was concentrated in specific sectors such as wireless communications services, airline tickets and hotel stays.
September was different. BofA said price increases have now spread to a broader range of goods and services, making it harder for the Fed to treat this inflation wave as a temporary blip.

Energy prices were the most obvious driver. The energy component of September’s CPI jumped 5.2%, with gasoline up 9.1%. BofA also linked higher airline ticket and rental‑car prices to the post‑Iran‑conflict rise in energy costs.

A more unexpected driver was AI. BofA said data‑center demand is spilling over to consumer tech products that use the same components. Prices for information‑technology goods rose 0.9% in September, adding about 0.02 percentage points to core CPI that month.

Goldman Sachs also spotted an AI‑related inflation effect. According to MarketWatch, Goldman estimates the AI boom adds roughly 0.45 percentage points to the annual core PCE inflation rate, but expects the impact to taper off by 2027.

Housing added another layer of complexity. Owners’ Equivalent Rent rose 0.35% in September, above August’s 0.19%. BofA does not expect rents to surge again, but believes the earlier slowdown in housing‑cost inflation is largely at an end.
Putting all the pressures together, BofA raised its tracking estimate for September core PCE inflation from a 0.22% monthly increase to 0.32%.
BofA predicts an October hike, while Citi sees a December move and Fed officials urge patience
Although BofA thinks the Fed faces a tough choice, not all Wall Street firms share the same urgency.
Citi, after September’s higher‑than‑expected inflation, revised its rate outlook and now expects a one‑basis‑point hike in December, followed by rate cuts starting in June 2027.

UBS forecasts Fed hikes in December and again in March 2027, and Morgan Stanley’s economists share that view. JPMorgan Wealth Management expects the Fed to raise rates by a total of 0.5 percentage points, though the timing remains highly uncertain.

Comments from Fed officials provide another reason for caution. Mary Daly, President of the San Francisco Fed, said the Fed does not have an urgent need to act in October, suggesting policymakers still have time to assess upcoming economic data.
Investors will closely watch inflation and employment numbers, energy prices, and movements in U.S. Treasury yields to gauge the Fed’s decision at the October meeting.

items.title: 美銀、花旗出手限制AI代理 銀行為何開始害怕「智慧理財」？
paras: 花旗（Citigroup）和美國銀行（BofA）已成為最新一批限制AI代理（AI agents）存取客戶帳戶的美國銀行。近期，多家銀行向監管機構表達擔憂，認為AI代理可能為了追求更高收益而轉移閒置現金，進而導致銀行存款流失。
花旗表示，不允許「第三方AI代理登入客戶帳戶，或直接在我們的數位銀行平台內進行交易」。該行補充說，這項措施旨在保護客戶帳戶及其訊息安全。
美銀執行長Brian Moynihan也暗示，該行正在限制AI代理存取消費者存款，同時制定相關協議，以釐清由AI代理授權的支付最終應由哪一方承擔責任。
本週稍早，Moynihan接受採訪時表示：「我們強烈認為，在資金從你的帳戶轉出之前，應該有人類參與並進行授權。」
他接著說：「你肯定不希望消費者回來告訴我們：『我的帳戶裡有一筆錢被轉走了，我不知道為什麼，也不知道錢去了哪裡，而這一切都是AI代理做的。』」
上月，Meta推出個人AI代理Muse。該產品迅速受到關注，也引發外界擔憂：AI代理可能代表消費者，將大量閒置現金從銀行存款帳戶轉移出去，以尋求更高收益。
Apollo經濟學家Torsten Slok警告，AI代理可能會自動將家庭閒置現金轉入年利率3.3%至5%的帳戶，而美國支票帳戶的全國平均利率僅有0.1%。
摩根大通、美國銀行和富國銀行目前合計持有約1.6兆美元的無息存款，相當於三家銀行負債的16%。如果這些存款需要支付3%的利息，銀行每年將增加約470億美元的利息成本。
如果銀行為了防止零售客戶將資金轉往其他地方賺取更高利率，而被迫提高存款利率，可能對銀行獲利造成重大打擊。
Slok寫道：「如果每個家庭都使用AI代理來最佳化現金餘額的收益率，那麼銀行可能會失去相當大一部分用於支應貸款業務的低成本存款，而這將成為整個金融體系的問題。」
監管機構私下對銀行阻止AI代理存取客戶帳戶的做法表示歡迎。監管官員認為，未來可能需要透過法律進一步釐清兩個問題：

客戶應如何授權自主運作的AI代理代表自己執行金融交易。
如果交易發生問題，究竟應由誰承擔法律責任。


花旗表示，在某些開放銀行服務商的平台上，客戶仍可授權對其帳戶訊息進行有限的唯讀存取。
摩根大通執行長戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）本週也表示，該行將嚴格限制AI代理存取客戶銀行帳戶。
戴蒙表示，「因為你不希望出現失控的AI代理，而且這樣的代理可能會有成千上萬個，我們必須確保以正確的方式保護客戶。因此，我們也正在開發相應的工具。」
他補充，「在此之前，我們不會允許任何外部AI代理隨意進入公司系統，因為這對客戶和摩根大通而言，風險都太高了。」
諮詢公司Simon-Kucher合夥人Christoph Stegmeier表示，銀行將越來越需要尋找方法，透過各種獎勵措施，讓客戶繼續將儲蓄留在銀行。
例如，銀行可以擴大客戶忠誠度計畫，並讓這些計畫影響客戶能獲得的貸款利率等金融產品條件。「你必須讓你的存款產品變得更有黏性。」

items.title: 「不是債市太悲觀就是股市太樂觀！」 高盛警告背離近臨界點：AI股恐再跌15%  點名對沖台灣半導體
items.title_en: "Either the bond market is too pessimistic or the stock market is too optimistic!" Goldman Sachs warns divergence nearing a tipping point: AI stocks may fall another 15% and names Taiwan semiconductor hedge
paras: 美國股市與信貸市場對AI題材的定價，正出現明顯裂口。高盛出具最新研報指出，AI超大型雲端廠商(hyperscaler)的信貸利差已擴大至年內最寬，但對應股價尚未充分反映壓力。
高盛策略師Louis Miller指出，市場正面臨二選一，「不是債市悲觀過頭，就是股市還有約15%下行空間未被消化。」
高盛AI超大型雲端廠商信貸利差指數(GSUCHS30)上週升至今年新高。Miller指出，7月利差接近此水準時，相關股票價格較現行水準低約15%。
此外，高盛AI受益股籃子相對「剔除AI成分」的標普500指數，已自6月高點回落約25%。信貸市場通常對現金流、融資成本與違約風險更敏感，這次率先反應，顯示市場辯論核心已從「AI需求有多強」轉向「資本支出能否回收」。
壓力不只在雲廠。超大型雲端廠商信用違約交換(CDS)觸及歷史新高，更下層的垃圾債市場中，20檔AI資料中心債券中有7檔還款來源依賴單一租戶CoreWeave，而CoreWeave債券殖利率已飆至15%左右、落入困境級區間。高盛認為，這是AI融資鏈從核心向外圍蔓延的訊號。
核心解釋在資本支出增速觸頂。高盛估算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出年增率約在今年第三季見頂(116%)，之後逐季放緩，2027年底降至約20%，重點不在總額立刻下滑，而在市場過去按「持續加速」給估值，一旦增速轉平，回報假設就要重算。
與此同時，折舊反噬是下一顆未爆彈。高盛測算，超大型雲端廠商資本支出扣除折舊後淨值，對標普EPS成長的貢獻，2026年約+11個百分點、2027年降至+7個百分點，2028年隨大量資料中心資產進入攤提高峰，貢獻轉為-1個百分點，原本支撐高獲利的AI投資，增速過後會變成利潤表拖累。
市場內部指標也同步轉弱。看跌選擇權成交量上週五(16日)升至年內次高水位；高盛高貝塔因子組合較高點跌15%；周期股相對防禦股隱含經濟成長預期降至約2%；避險基金貝塔調整後淨部位處在五年第67百分位、淨槓桿僅第17百分位，顯示「想跟AI順勢」但槓桿沒跟上。金融條件由正轉負，更高利率與更寬利差直接壓負債依賴股。
不過，Miller並未斷言指數崩盤，而是稱市場正以輪動消化壓力，並給出五項應對策略：一、做多剔除AI的寬基市場，AI與非AI相關性已轉負；二、做多品質因子但防技術面過熱，質量因子三個月漲20%、RSI破80；三、中期醫療保健，押ACA補貼延長帶動就醫流量；四、做多巴西非相關機會，總統決選舉行前後估值有重估空間；五、對沖台灣半導體部位，因台積電調高指引後股價仍偏弱，亞洲團隊建議做空台灣半導體籃子。
對投資人而言，高盛這份周報的重點不是「AI結束」，而是定價階段切換：股價還在講成長，債市已開始算折舊與融資成本。若信貸利差續擴，AI概念股補跌風險將從邊緣租戶、NeoCloud、光通訊與記憶體鏈，逐步回推至核心雲巨頭與半導體龍頭。
paras_en: The pricing of AI themes in U.S. equities and credit markets is showing a clear split. Goldman Sachs' latest research note says credit spreads for AI hyperscale cloud providers have widened to the widest level this year, yet stock prices have not yet fully reflected the pressure.
Goldman strategist Louis Miller notes the market faces a binary choice: "Either the bond market is overly pessimistic, or the stock market still has about 15% downside not yet priced in."

The Goldman AI hyperscale cloud credit spread index (GSUCHS30) rose to a new high for the year last week. Miller points out that when spreads were near this level in July, the related stock prices were roughly 15% lower than current levels.

Moreover, the basket of AI beneficiary stocks relative to the S&P 500 "excluding AI components" has fallen about 25% from its June peak. Credit markets, which are more sensitive to cash flow, financing costs and default risk, reacted first, indicating the debate has shifted from "how strong AI demand is" to "whether capital spending can be recouped."

The pressure isn’t limited to cloud providers. Credit default swaps on hyperscale cloud firms hit historic highs, and in the junk bond market, 7 of 20 AI data‑center bonds rely on a single tenant, CoreWeave, whose bond yields have surged to roughly 15% and entered distressed territory. Goldman sees this as a signal that AI financing is spreading from the core to the periphery.

The core issue is a peak in capital‑expenditure growth. Goldman estimates hyperscale cloud cap‑ex annual growth will top out in Q3 this year at about 116%, then slow each quarter, falling to roughly 20% by the end of 2027. The focus isn’t an immediate drop in total spend, but the market’s valuation built on a "continuous acceleration" narrative, which must be re‑calculated once growth flattens.

At the same time, depreciation backlash is the next hidden bomb. Goldman calculates that after subtracting depreciation, the net contribution of hyperscale cloud cap‑ex to S&P EPS growth will be about +11 percentage points in 2026, drop to +7 points in 2027, and turn negative (‑1 point) in 2028 as massive data‑center assets hit peak amortization, turning what once supported high AI profits into a profit‑and‑loss drag.

Internal market indicators are also weakening. Put‑option volume rose to the second‑highest level of the year last Friday (the 16th); Goldman’s high‑beta factor portfolio is down 15% from its peak; cyclical stocks’ implied growth expectations relative to defensive stocks have fallen to about 2%; hedge‑fund beta‑adjusted net positions sit at the 67th percentile of the past five years and net leverage at the 17th percentile, showing a desire to ride the AI wave without sufficient leverage. Financial conditions have turned negative, with higher rates and wider spreads directly squeezing debt‑heavy stocks.

However, Miller does not predict a full index collapse. He says the market is rotating to absorb pressure and outlines five strategies: 1) go long the broad market excluding AI, as AI‑related and non‑AI assets are now negatively correlated; 2) go long quality factors while avoiding an overheated tech side—quality factors have risen 20% in three months and RSI has broken 80; 3) mid‑term healthcare, betting on extended ACA subsidies driving patient volume; 4) go long Brazil’s non‑correlated opportunities, where valuation could be reset around the presidential election; 5) hedge Taiwan semiconductor exposure, as TSMC’s stock remains weak despite raised guidance, with the Asian team recommending shorting a Taiwan semiconductor basket.

For investors, the key takeaway from Goldman’s weekly note isn’t that "AI is over," but that the pricing phase is shifting: stocks are still talking growth, while the bond market is already pricing depreciation and financing costs. If credit spreads keep widening, the risk of further AI‑related stock pull‑backs will move from edge tenants, NeoCloud, optical‑communication and memory chains back toward core cloud giants and semiconductor leaders.

items.title: 破天荒！韓媒：三星將採台積電3奈米製程  為輝達生產下一代HBM基底裸片
items.title_en: Breaking Ground! Korean Media: Samsung to Use TSMC 3nm Process for Nvidia's Next-Gen HBM Base Dies
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，南韓三星電子將打破長達數年的「一站式全包」生產模式，採用台積電的3奈米製程，為輝達下一代HBM製造基底裸片(base die)。
韓媒《首爾經濟日報》今(18)日引述消息人士報導，輝達已向三星、SK海力士及美光三家供應商提出統一要求，基底裸片必須使用台積電3奈米工製成，核心裸片則統一採用第六代DRAM工藝(1c)，這一要求源於各供應商製造方案差異導致性能不穩，標準化可大幅減輕輝達的驗證工作量。
報道指出，三星設備解決方案事業部經內部評估後，決定接受輝達要求。三星此次調整僅針對輝達客製化的HBM4E產品。對於標準版HBM及面向超微等其他客戶的產品，三星仍將保留全包生產策略。
目前，三星已全球率先量產第六代HBM4，第七代HBM4E正進行量產驗證，兩款產品的基底裸片均採用三星自研4奈米製程。
值得注意的是，三星並未完全放棄自主生產能力。一位業內人士透露，三星正同步驗證能否在自有產線製造輝達HBM基底裸片，作為防範台積電產能不足的備案，此舉顯示在AI晶片競爭白熱化下，三星正以靈活策略平衡技術自主與客戶需求。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that South Korea's Samsung Electronics will break its years‑long "single‑source full‑pack" production model and adopt TSMC’s 3‑nanometer process to make the base dies for Nvidia’s next‑generation HBM.

Korean outlet Seoul Economic Daily cited sources saying Nvidia has issued a unified request to its three suppliers—Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron—that the base dies be fabricated with TSMC’s 3nm technology, while the core dies use a sixth‑generation DRAM process (1c). The demand stems from performance instability caused by differing manufacturing approaches, and standardisation would greatly reduce Nvidia’s validation workload.

The report says Samsung’s Equipment Solutions division, after an internal review, decided to meet Nvidia’s request. The adjustment applies only to Nvidia‑customised HBM4E products; for standard‑edition HBM and products for other customers such as AMD, Samsung will retain its full‑pack production strategy.

Samsung is currently the first worldwide to mass‑produce sixth‑generation HBM4, and seventh‑generation HBM4E is undergoing volume‑production qualification. Both products’ base dies are made with Samsung’s own 4‑nanometer process.

It is noteworthy that Samsung has not completely abandoned its own manufacturing capability. An industry insider disclosed that Samsung is simultaneously testing whether it can produce Nvidia’s HBM base dies on its own lines as a contingency in case TSMC capacity falls short, showing that amid the fierce AI‑chip battle Samsung is using a flexible strategy to balance technological independence with customer needs.

items.title: 從聖彼得堡到莫斯科州 俄羅斯多地遭大規模無人機襲擊
items.title_en: From St. Petersburg to Moscow Oblast, Russia Hit by Large-Scale Drone Attacks
paras: 俄羅斯國防部18日（周日）通報，自17日20時至18日8時，境內多地遭無人機襲擊，防空部隊在別爾哥羅德州、布良斯克州、列寧格勒州、莫斯科州等地及黑海上空攔截、擊落1,015架烏克蘭無人機。
《塔斯社》稱，此次無人機襲擊為今年來最大規模襲擊之一。
俄羅斯聖彼得堡市市長別格洛夫18日在社交媒體上說，聖彼得堡當日凌晨遭無人機襲擊，已造成1人死亡、5人受傷。
俄羅斯航空署稱，聖彼得堡普爾科沃機場當天已暫停飛機起降，乘客和工作人員均被疏散至安全地區。
俄羅斯列寧格勒州州長德羅茲堅科18日在社交媒體上說，該州當天凌晨共擊落144架無人機。無人機殘骸墜落導致當地一座公寓大樓、一棟民宅和供電線路受損，部分地區斷電。
俄羅斯國防部18日表示，武裝部隊繼續對烏克蘭物流中心、港口及船隻實施打擊，造成烏克蘭羅夫諾市一處用於儲存和分發無人機部件等貨物的物流中心受損。
此外，俄軍還在敖德薩港以東30公里處打擊一艘載有軍民兩用貨物的乾貨船。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基18日表示，自美國總統川普宣布「能源停火」以來，俄羅斯已對烏克蘭能源和油氣產業發動76次打擊。
本月18日凌晨，烏文尼察州、日托米爾州、赫梅利尼茨基州和敖德薩州的變電站遭襲，導致數萬家庭斷電。俄軍當天還襲擊居民住宅，造成12人受傷、2人死亡。
澤倫斯基說，俄軍過去一周發射近2,700架無人機、1,700枚航空炸彈和66枚飛彈，其中大部分為彈道飛彈。俄軍的主要目標是能源設施。
paras_en: The Russian Ministry of Defence reported on Sunday the 18th that from 20:00 on the 17th to 08:00 on the 18th, multiple regions of the country were attacked by drones, and air‑defence forces intercepted and shot down 1,015 Ukrainian drones over Belgorod, Bryansk, Leningrad, Moscow oblasts and the Black Sea airspace.
TASS said the drone attacks were among the largest of the year.
St. Petersburg Mayor Alexander Beglov said on social media that the city was hit by a drone attack in the early hours of the day, killing one person and injuring five.
The Russian Federal Air Transport Agency said that flights at St. Petersburg’s Pulkovo Airport were suspended that day and passengers and staff were evacuated to safe areas.

Leningrad Oblast Governor Aleksandr Drozdenko said on social media that the region shot down 144 drones in the early hours, and debris from the drones damaged an apartment block, a private house and power lines, causing power outages in some areas.

The Defence Ministry said the armed forces continued to strike Ukrainian logistics centres, ports and vessels, damaging a logistics hub in the city of Rovenky that stored and distributed drone components and other goods.
In addition, Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship carrying dual‑use cargo about 30 km east of the port of Odesa.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on the 18th that since U.S. President Donald Trump announced an “energy cease‑fire,” Russia has carried out 76 attacks on Ukraine’s energy and oil‑gas sector.

In the early hours of the 18th, substations in the Ukrainian regions of Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi and Odesa were hit, cutting power to tens of thousands of households, and Russian forces also attacked residential buildings, wounding 12 people and killing two.
Zelensky said Russian forces in the past week launched nearly 2,700 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs and 66 missiles, most of them ballistic, with energy facilities being the main target.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：Meta及特斯拉財報、AI漲勢動搖、Fed升息預期
paras: 隨著引領市場的AI交易近期遭遇挫折，華爾街本週將聚焦Meta Platforms(META-US)等重要企業即將公布的財報，市場也將藉此檢驗投資人對這波漲勢的信心。
AI概念股票是這波美股多頭行情的核心，而這波行情才剛迎來四週年。然而，相關類股近幾日表現疲弱，半導體公司及戴爾科技(DELL-US)等科技硬體企業股價大幅下跌。
Meta是大舉投資AI資料中心建設的超大規模雲端服務商之一，將成為這週財報季焦點之一。此外，半導體設備商科林研發(LRCX-US)、德州儀器(TXN-US)，以及馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉 (TSLA-US)也將公布財報。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions投資組合策略師Garrett Melson表示，「市場目前的氛圍確實有些不安。顯然AI目前的發展方向仍存在許多不確定性。」
市場近期開始擔憂AI基礎建設熱潮的融資風險。這波投資熱潮推升了許多企業的獲利，也帶動經濟成長。投資人密切關注AI雲端公司CoreWeave (CRWV-US)最新發展，該公司負債約500億美元，上週股價重挫。
其他謹慎訊號還包括，德銀與加拿大皇家銀行資本市場策略師近期分別下調對科技類股的看好程度。德銀策略師10月9日表示，資金輪動至科技股的行情「已經走得太遠，短期內的風險報酬前景不再有利」。
受到大型科技股與AI類股大幅下跌拖累，標普500指數上週創6月以來最大單週跌幅。不過，該指數距離本月創下的歷史高點仍僅約2%。相較之下，上個月因科技股強勢而落後的其他類股表現穩健，醫療保健與民生必需品類股均有所上漲。
Melson表示，「這確實是一個行情開關不斷切換的市場。當AI類股表現強勢時，就會吸走其他所有類股的市場關注度。」

Meta打頭陣 大型雲端業者財報登場

美股財報季熱度升溫，投資人期待企業交出強勁成績。根據LSEG IBES，標普500成分股企業第三季獲利預計年增逾30%。
AI資料中心與基礎設施的大規模支出，是推動獲利成長的重要因素。高盛估計，Meta在內的五家AI超大規模雲端服務商，明年資本支出合計預計將增至約1.2兆美元。投資人正急於尋找訊號，確認這些企業能從相關投資中獲得回報，以建立對這種支出模式可持續性的信心。
紐約梅隆銀行股票分析師Kevin Shea表示，「財報季最重要的觀察重點之一，是超大規模雲端服務商的獲利成長速度，能否超越資本支出的成長速度。」
Meta市值約1.8兆美元，近期隨著公司推出Muse AI助理，股價有所上漲。
Horizon Investment Services執行長Chuck Carlson表示，「隨著資金成本上升，這種大幅擴張的資本支出將變得更加昂貴，也進一步提高了投資報酬的門檻。Meta將率先公布財報，市場也將期待公司對這個問題提供更多說明。」

半導體廠、特斯拉接力公布財報

晶片公司一直是這波資本支出熱潮最大受益者之一，但相關股票近期漲勢已經降溫。費城半導體指數本月下跌約12%，儘管如此，今年以來仍上漲57%，遠高於標普500指數約12%的年初至今漲幅。
科林研發與德州儀器週三公布的財報，可能為半導體產業的整體需求提供更廣泛訊號。科林研發今年以來股價上漲54%，德州儀器則上漲59%。
投資人也將關注馬斯克旗下兩家市值遠超過1兆美元的企業財報：同時經營AI業務的太空公司SpaceX，以及作為科技股帶動美股多頭行情代表之一的特斯拉。
其他本週將公布財報的重要企業，還包括串流媒體公司Netflix(NFLX-US)、消費用品公司寶僑(PG-US)，以及航空引擎製造商GE Aerospace(GE-US)。

聯準會10月升息預期降溫

美國公債殖利率上升，以及聯準會(Fed)可能進一步升息的前景，也仍是投資人關注焦點。
上週公布的高於預期的通膨數據，一度提高了市場對聯準會在10月底會議再次升息的押注。不過，期貨價格顯示，多數投資人仍預期美國央行將等到12月會議，才進行今年第二次升息。
瑞銀全球財富管理分析師週四在報告中表示，「如果本次財報季表現同樣強勁，將有助於股市抵禦利率溫和上升帶來的壓力。」
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。

items.title: 法國55萬人大遊行 1,200人被捕 馬克宏發聲
items.title_en: France 550,000 People March, 1,200 Arrested, Macron Speaks Out
paras: 法國內政部長洛朗·努內茲17日（周六）就國內各地抗議活動和警方應對措施發布最新消息，各地當天共舉行了110場遊行，共計55萬名抗議者參與，這是法國近年來最嚴重暴力騷亂之一。
法國總理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科爾努表示，約1,200人被捕。法國警察工會UNSA在X平台上發布了一段影片，顯示多地人群用棍棒和磚塊襲擊警車，並警告警方已不堪重負。
巴黎市中心著名地標，包括香榭麗舍大街、協和廣場、共和國廣場等，都發生抗議活動。許多商店和餐館被砸，汽車和垃圾桶被縱火焚燒。
法國中西部上維埃納省利摩日市市政廳被縱火，這座擁有140年歷史的建築的女兒牆在火災中坍塌。
當地官員莫里斯·巴拉特表示，該建築「除西翼外，屋頂已坍塌至較低樓層，且三分之二外牆已經消失。」巴拉特稱，市政廳所受嚴重破壞是「文化遺產災難」，譴責相關舉動是「流氓蓄意行徑」。
《法新社》援引目擊者消息稱，一群蒙面抗議者在市政廳外焚燒一輛警車後，砸碎窗戶闖入大樓縱火。
里昂旅遊局辦公室遭縱火，當地照片顯示，辦公室窗戶被砸碎，整棟建築被火焰吞噬。
法國總統馬克宏表示，絕不容忍暴力。「那些破壞、襲擊政府機關與商鋪、甚至洗劫市政廳的人，都會被起訴、懲處。」馬克宏在帖文中說。
paras_en: France's interior minister Laurent Nunez announced on Saturday that protests took place across the country, with 110 marches on the day and a total of 550,000 demonstrators, making it one of the most severe bouts of violence in recent years.

Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said about 1,200 people were arrested. The police union UNSA posted a video on X showing crowds in multiple locations attacking police cars with clubs and bricks, warning that police were overwhelmed.

Major landmarks in central Paris, including the Champs‑Élysées, Place de la Concorde and Place de la République, saw protests. Many shops and restaurants were smashed, and cars and trash cans were set on fire.
The town hall in Limoges, in the Haute‑Vienne department of central‑western France, was set ablaze; the 140‑year‑old building’s south wall collapsed in the fire.

Local official Maurice Baratte said the building’s “roof has collapsed down to lower floors except for the west wing, and two‑thirds of the exterior walls have disappeared.” He called the severe damage a “cultural‑heritage disaster” and condemned the act as “deliberate hooligan behaviour.”
AFP cited eyewitnesses who said a group of masked protesters set a police car on fire outside the town hall, then smashed windows to break into the building and set it alight.
The Lyon tourism office was torched; photos showed its windows shattered and the entire structure engulfed in flames.

President Emmanuel Macron said violence would not be tolerated. “Those who vandalise, attack government offices and shops, or even loot town halls will be prosecuted and punished,” he wrote in a post.

items.title: 中國AI算力版圖悄悄洗牌？阿里巴巴、華為、字節跳動搶進內蒙古，這座城市究竟有什麼吸引力？
items.title_en: Is China’s AI Computing Landscape Quietly Shuffling? Alibaba, Huawei, and ByteDance Rush into Inner Mongolia—What Makes This City So Attractive?
paras: 2026年10月18日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著人工智慧（AI）應用快速擴張，中國正加速在內蒙古等能源資源豐富的地區興建大型資料中心，試圖利用低廉電價、充足土地及快速施工能力，擴大AI算力基礎設施。其中，過去以農業及重工業為主的烏蘭察布，正迅速轉型為中國重要的AI算力中心，吸引阿里巴巴Alibaba(BABA-US)、華為Huawei、字節跳動ByteDance等科技企業投入建設。
中國發展AI的競爭優勢，已不僅限於演算法及晶片技術，也包括資料中心建設速度、電力供應與基礎設施成本。儘管中國仍面臨先進AI晶片供應不足的限制，但在土地取得、電網連接及施工效率方面，正展現明顯的成本與建設優勢。
研究機構SemiAnalysis估計，中國目前已投入營運的資料中心容量超過亞洲其他地區總和，另有約50 GW的新增資料中心電力容量處於規劃或開發階段。隨著建設持續推進，中國與美國在AI基礎設施規模方面的差距可能進一步縮小，但算力效能仍取決於高階AI晶片的取得能力。

阿里巴巴、華為與字節跳動進駐，烏蘭察布形成大型資料中心聚落
烏蘭察布位於中國內蒙古自治區，距離北京約2小時高鐵車程。當地過去主要依賴馬鈴薯種植、畜牧業及傳統工業，如今隨著AI算力需求快速成長，正成為中國資料中心建設最密集的地區之一。
目前烏蘭察布郊區至少有4座大型資料中心園區正在施工，參與企業約12家，包括阿里巴巴、華為，以及專業資料中心營運商ZData與萬國數據服務同業VNET(VNET-US)等。其中，字節跳動是當地資料中心租賃服務的主要客戶，AI模型開發商DeepSeek及智譜AI（Z.ai）也正在當地建設運算設施。
華為目前在烏蘭察布擁有3座資料中心。華為輪值董事長徐直軍今年8月首次造訪當地時，對資料中心建設規模感到意外。他指出，當地具備低電價優勢，加上高鐵可快速連接北京，使烏蘭察布成為部署大型算力設施的理想地點。
烏蘭察布目前已承諾投入的資料中心電力容量約15 GW，而已建成及規劃中的設施合計涉及89座資料中心，擴張速度在亞洲主要資料中心聚落中名列前茅。

內蒙古電價僅北京約45%，充足電力成為AI算力擴張關鍵
電力成本是烏蘭察布吸引科技企業投資的主要因素。截至今年6月，內蒙古已建置約117 GW風力發電裝置容量，為中國規模最大的風電基地，約相當於英國整體風電裝置容量的4倍。此外，內蒙古還擁有約130 GW化石燃料發電容量，其中以燃煤發電為主。
由於資源相當充足，內蒙古可能是全球地方行政區中電力供應過剩最明顯的地區之一。由於部分發電設施利用率偏低，大型資料中心的進駐有助於吸收當地剩餘電力，改善發電資產的使用效率。
從電價來看，烏蘭察布每度電約0.358 yuan，明顯低於中國許多城市超過0.60 yuan的工業電價，也只有北京約0.80 yuan電價的45%左右。
對於需全年持續運轉、耗電量龐大的AI資料中心而言，電力成本差距將直接影響長期營運費用，也使中國大型科技企業更有誘因將算力設施部署至能源成本較低的內陸地區。
除了電價優勢，內蒙古年平均氣溫約4.3°C，寒冷氣候有助於降低資料中心冷卻系統的能源消耗，進一步改善整體電力使用效率。
當地電網架構也提供額外優勢。內蒙古部分地區由獨立運作的蒙西電網供電，使部分資料中心專案能直接連接專用發電設施，降低電力傳輸限制及相關費用。
不過，內蒙古同時存在水資源不足的問題。由於大型資料中心需要冷卻設施維持伺服器運作，若未來算力容量持續快速增加，水資源供應可能成為限制當地資料中心擴張的重要因素。

建設成本低20%、施工期縮短至12至18個月，模組化設計加快擴張
除了電力優勢，中國資料中心建設成本及施工速度也具有競爭力。
根據高盛Goldman Sachs(GS-US)估計，烏蘭察布資料中心的建設成本較中國主要城市低約20%。當地建設工程大量採用標準化模組設計，並從其他省分引進數千名工人，在工地周邊設置臨時住宿設施，以提高施工效率。
目前不少資料中心工程預計可在12至18個月內完成，相較之下，美國同類型設施一般需要18至24個月。
中國業者主要採用預製模組化資料中心設計，將伺服器機櫃及相關設備整合至標準化單元，再運送到現場快速組裝。這種建設方式被形容為「樂高式資料中心」，其概念也已被部分美國超大型雲端服務業者採用。
隨著資料中心建設規模持續擴大，烏蘭察布周邊也逐漸形成包含能源設備、冷卻系統及基礎設施工程的產業供應鏈。
例如，遠景科技集團Envision正在當地多座資料中心附近興建綠色能源專案，規劃完成後可提供約2 GW電力，理論上足以支援最多100萬張AI加速運算卡的電力需求。
此外，資料中心建設也帶動液冷設備需求。維諦技術Vertiv(VRT-US)的液冷系統已出現在ZData與Centrin Data System的資料中心設施中。
這反映AI算力基礎設施投資正在帶動上游電力設備、散熱系統、伺服器機櫃及模組化資料中心等相關產業需求。當能源供應、設備組裝及資料中心施工集中於同一區域時，也有助於縮短運輸距離與建置時間。

AI代理應用帶動算力需求，資料中心租賃價格上升
儘管中國資料中心建設速度快速，市場仍關注是否可能出現投資過剩。
對此，部分分析師認為，AI應用需求成長仍可支撐新增算力供給。
傑富瑞分析師Edison Lee指出，隨著AI代理（AI Agents）應用快速發展，AI模型推論所需的運算量持續增加，帶動資料中心算力租賃需求與價格同步上升。
其中，AI模型處理的Token數量快速成長，是推升運算需求的重要因素。
相較於過去主要由AI模型訓練帶動的集中式運算需求，AI代理可自主執行多步驟任務，涉及反覆推理、工具調用及資訊處理，可能增加推論階段的算力消耗。
這也使AI基礎設施投資逐漸從單純擴充GPU運算設備，延伸至電力供應、冷卻系統、資料中心建設及算力租賃服務等領域。

先進AI晶片供應仍是瓶頸，中國以電價優惠推動國產晶片採用
雖然中國在資料中心建設及能源成本方面具有優勢，但先進AI晶片供應仍是限制算力擴張的重要因素。
受到美國出口管制，以及中國本土晶圓代工廠先進製程產能有限的影響，中國科技企業取得高效能AI加速器仍面臨挑戰。
為降低對輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)晶片的依賴，中國政府正透過財政及能源價格政策，鼓勵資料中心採用國產AI處理器。
採用中國本土晶片的資料中心，可獲得較優惠的稅務待遇，以及電力與用水價格折扣，藉此提高國產晶片的使用誘因。
這也使中國AI算力產業呈現兩種不同的發展速度：一方面，資料中心建築、電力設施及散熱基礎建設快速增加；另一方面，先進AI晶片的供應能力仍受到製程技術及產能限制。
對於烏蘭察布等快速擴張的算力中心而言，未來能否將新增資料中心容量有效轉化為實際運算能力，將取決於國產AI加速器的性能提升、先進晶片供應，以及AI推論需求能否持續成長。

paras_en: On October 18, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industrial Data Center Report) – As AI applications expand rapidly, China is accelerating the construction of large data centers in energy-rich regions such as Inner Mongolia, aiming to leverage low electricity prices, ample land, and fast construction to expand its AI computing infrastructure. Formerly dominated by agriculture and heavy industry, Ulanqab is quickly transforming into a key AI computing hub, attracting tech giants Alibaba (BABA-US), Huawei, and ByteDance.

China’s competitive edge in AI development is no longer limited to algorithms and chip technology; it also includes the speed of data center construction, power supply, and infrastructure costs. Although China still faces shortages of advanced AI chips, it shows clear cost and construction advantages in land acquisition, grid connection, and construction efficiency.

Research firm SemiAnalysis estimates that China’s operating data center capacity now exceeds the total of other Asian regions, with about 50 GW of new data center power capacity in planning or development. As construction continues, the gap in AI infrastructure scale between China and the United States may narrow further, but computing performance still depends on access to high‑end AI chips.

Alibaba, Huawei, and ByteDance have entered Ulanqab, forming a large data center cluster. Ulanqab, located in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, is about a two‑hour high‑speed rail ride from Beijing. The area, once reliant on potato farming, livestock, and traditional industry, is now becoming one of China’s most densely built data center regions due to the rapid growth in AI computing demand.

Currently, at least four large data center parks are under construction in the outskirts of Ulanqab, involving about 12 companies, including Alibaba, Huawei, and specialized data center operators ZData and VNET (VNET-US). ByteDance is the main tenant for data center leasing services, and AI model developers DeepSeek and Z.ai are also building computing facilities there.

Huawei currently owns three data centers in Ulanqab. When Chairman‑in‑Residence Xu Zhijun visited the area in August, he was surprised by the scale of data center construction. He noted the region’s low electricity price advantage and the high‑speed rail link to Beijing, making Ulanqab an ideal location for deploying large computing facilities.

Ulanqab has pledged about 15 GW of data center power capacity, and the total of completed and planned facilities involves 89 data centers, placing it among the fastest‑growing data center clusters in Asia.

Inner Mongolia’s electricity price is only about 45% of Beijing’s, making abundant power a key factor in AI computing expansion. By June of this year, Inner Mongolia had installed about 117 GW of wind power capacity, the largest wind farm in China, roughly four times the total wind capacity of the UK. In addition, Inner Mongolia has about 130 GW of fossil‑fuel power capacity, mainly coal‑based.

With abundant resources, Inner Mongolia may be one of the most obvious regions of excess power supply among global local administrative areas. Because some power plants operate at low utilization, the arrival of large data centers helps absorb surplus electricity and improve the utilization of power assets.

In terms of price, Ulanqab’s electricity costs about 0.358 yuan per kWh, clearly lower than the industrial rates above 0.60 yuan in many Chinese cities and about 45% of Beijing’s roughly 0.80 yuan per kWh.

For AI data centers that must run continuously year‑round and consume massive power, the electricity cost gap directly impacts long‑term operating expenses, giving Chinese tech giants stronger incentives to deploy computing facilities in inland areas with lower energy costs.

Beyond electricity price advantages, Inner Mongolia’s average annual temperature of about 4.3°C provides a cold climate that helps reduce the energy consumption of data center cooling systems, further improving overall power efficiency.

The local grid structure also offers additional benefits. Parts of Inner Mongolia are powered by the independent Mongolian West Grid, allowing some data center projects to connect directly to dedicated power plants, reducing transmission constraints and related costs.

However, Inner Mongolia also faces water scarcity. As large data centers require cooling facilities to keep servers running, continued rapid growth in computing capacity could make water supply a limiting factor for local data center expansion.

Construction costs are 20% lower and construction periods shortened to 12–18 months, with modular design accelerating expansion. In addition to power advantages, China’s data center construction costs and speed are competitive.

According to Goldman Sachs (GS-US), construction costs for Ulanqab data centers are about 20% lower than in major Chinese cities. Local projects heavily use standardized modular designs and bring thousands of workers from other provinces, setting up temporary housing near sites to boost construction efficiency.
Many data center projects are expected to be completed within 12–18 months, compared with 18–24 months for similar facilities in the United States.

Chinese operators mainly use prefabricated modular data center designs, integrating server racks and related equipment into standardized units, then transporting them to the site for rapid assembly. This construction method is described as a “LEGO‑style data center” and has been adopted by some large US cloud providers.
As data center construction scales up, Ulanqab’s surrounding area is gradually forming an industrial supply chain that includes energy equipment, cooling systems, and infrastructure engineering.

For example, Envision Group is building green energy projects near several data centers in the area, which, once completed, can provide about 2 GW of power, theoretically enough to support up to one million AI accelerator cards.
In addition, data center construction has driven demand for liquid cooling equipment. Vertiv (VRT-US) liquid cooling systems have appeared in ZData and Centrin Data System facilities.

This reflects that AI computing infrastructure investment is driving upstream demand for power equipment, cooling systems, server racks, and modular data centers. When energy supply, equipment assembly, and data center construction are concentrated in the same region, it also helps shorten transportation distances and build times.

AI agent applications are driving computing demand, raising data center leasing prices. Despite the rapid pace of data center construction in China, the market still wonders whether investment surplus may occur.
Some analysts believe that the growth of AI application demand can still support additional computing supply.

Edison Lee, an analyst at Jirufei, pointed out that as AI agent applications rapidly develop, the computational load required for AI model inference continues to rise, driving data center computing rental demand and prices upward in tandem.
A key factor driving the increase in computational demand is the rapid growth in the number of tokens processed by AI models.

Compared with the past, where centralized computing demand was mainly driven by AI model training, AI agents can autonomously perform multi‑step tasks involving repeated inference, tool invocation, and information processing, potentially increasing inference‑stage computing consumption.

This also means that investment in AI infrastructure is gradually shifting from simply expanding GPU compute equipment to extending into power supply, cooling systems, data center construction, and compute‑rental services.

Advanced AI chip supply remains a bottleneck; China promotes domestic chip adoption with preferential electricity pricing. Although China has advantages in data center construction and energy costs, advanced AI chip supply still limits computing expansion.
Due to U.S. export controls and limited advanced process capacity at domestic wafer fabs, Chinese tech firms still face challenges in acquiring high‑performance AI accelerators.
To reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips, the Chinese government is encouraging data centers to adopt domestic AI processors through fiscal and energy pricing policies.
Data centers using domestic chips can receive more favorable tax treatment and discounts on electricity and water prices, thereby increasing incentives to use domestic chips.

This has led to two different development speeds in China’s AI computing industry: on one hand, data center construction, power facilities, and cooling infrastructure are rapidly increasing; on the other hand, advanced AI chip supply remains constrained by process technology and capacity.

For rapidly expanding computing hubs like Ulanqab, whether future added data center capacity can be effectively translated into actual computing power will depend on performance improvements of domestic AI accelerators, advanced chip supply, and whether AI inference demand continues to grow.

items.title: 中國擬管制12項太陽能製造技術出口，先啟動登記、涵蓋關鍵設備
items.title_en: China Plans to Regulate Export of 12 Solar Manufacturing Technologies, Starting with Registration and Covering Key Equipment
paras: 2026年10月18日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國擬收緊太陽能製造技術對外移轉。商務部與科技部10月16日公布修訂草案，計畫將多晶矽、矽晶圓及太陽能電池製造相關12項技術，納入禁止或限制出口範圍，並涵蓋承載相關技術的部分關鍵設備。草案徵詢意見至11月15日；正式管制內容尚待定案，但出口前登記已自公告日起實施。
草案採分級管理。厚度70微米以下的矽晶圓製造技術，以及達到指定量產效率、尺寸等條件的鈣鈦礦與疊層電池技術，擬列為禁止出口；符合門檻的TOPCon、背接觸及異質結電池製程，則擬列為限制出口，須依規定申請許可。商務部表示，太陽能技術在航太、國防及高安全等級基礎設施等領域的應用增加，是此次加強管理的考量。
影響將落在技術與產線移轉，而非利用這些技術製成的電池片或模組成品。商務部說明，相關技術往往隨產線出口、安裝、調校與升級移轉；因此，海外建廠若需引進列管製程及設備，規劃時也須納入技術出口程序。未達管制門檻的技術仍可自由出口，未列明的其他太陽能設備原則上不適用此次要求。
目前的登記要求涵蓋向境外轉讓技術所有權、授權海外使用，以及技術所有者或實際控制人改為境外主體等情況，已開始但尚未完成的出口也須登記。涉及相關技術的海外擴產案，在最終目錄公布前就需先完成申報。

※ 免責聲明：文中所提的個股、基金、期貨商品內容僅供參考，並非投資建議，投資人應獨立判斷，審慎評估風險。
paras_en: On October 18, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China intends to tighten the outward transfer of solar manufacturing technologies. The Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Science and Technology released a revised draft on October 16, proposing to place twelve technologies related to polysilicon, silicon wafers and solar cell manufacturing under a ban or export‑restriction regime, and to include certain key equipment that carries these technologies. The draft is open for comment until November 15; the final regulatory content is yet to be decided, but registration before export has been in effect since the announcement.

The draft adopts a tiered management approach. Manufacturing techniques for silicon wafers thinner than 70 micrometres, as well as perovskite and tandem cell technologies that meet specified mass‑production efficiency and size criteria, are slated for a ban on export; TOPCon, back‑contact and heterojunction cell processes that meet the thresholds are to be restricted, requiring a licence application. The Ministry of Commerce said the growing use of solar technology in aerospace, defence and high‑security infrastructure is a key reason for the tighter controls.

The impact will fall on the transfer of technology and production lines, not on solar cells or modules already made with those technologies. The ministry explained that the relevant know‑how usually moves together with the export, installation, commissioning and upgrade of production lines; therefore, overseas plants that wish to import the listed processes and equipment must incorporate the technology‑export procedures into their planning. Technologies that do not meet the control thresholds may still be exported freely, and other solar equipment not listed is generally not subject to this requirement.

The current registration requirement covers situations such as transferring technology ownership abroad, licensing overseas use, and cases where the technology owner or actual controller becomes a foreign entity; exports that have already started but are not yet completed must also be registered. Overseas expansion projects involving the relevant technologies must complete the filing before the final catalogue is published.

items.title: 2029年現記憶體「紅海」？韓國財長：半導體繁榮至少持續至明年
items.title_en: Memory Market a “Red Sea” by 2029? South Korean Finance Minister: Semiconductor Boom Will Last at Least Until Next Year
paras: 韓國財政部長李炯日（Lee Hyoung-Il）周六（17日）表示，半導體產業的繁榮勢頭至少會持續到2027年。
「目前我們認為增長至少可以持續到明年，這是因為半導體供需缺口仍然非常大，而且供應端仍在持續擴張。」李炯日在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金（IMF）和世界銀行年會期間接受媒體採訪時表示。
供應端擴張指的是資本開支、在建產能擴張，表明當下晶片產業景氣仍非常高，需求旺盛，儘管從長期來看，這意味著供需缺口將縮窄。
李炯日表示，今年晶片股引發了韓國股市劇烈波動。他將市場的劇烈震盪歸因於半導體產業佔韓國經濟的比重比其他國家高。儘管市場大幅波動，李炯日仍表示，韓國經濟「基本面穩健」。
韓國主要商業日報《每日經濟新聞》周四一篇評論文章呼籲政府為人工智慧熱潮即將到來的放緩做好準備。該文作者援引兩位專家的觀點，稱預計到2029年半導體將出現大量新增供應，屆時記憶體晶片市場將變成「紅海」。
paras_en: South Korean Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-Il said on Saturday (the 17th) that the momentum of the semiconductor industry’s prosperity is expected to continue at least until 2027.

“We currently believe that growth can last at least until next year because the semiconductor supply‑demand gap remains very large, and the supply side is still expanding,” Lee said in a media interview during the International Monetary Fund and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok.

The expansion on the supply side refers to capital expenditures and construction of new capacity, indicating that the chip industry is still in a very strong cycle with robust demand, even though in the long run this will narrow the supply‑demand gap.

Lee noted that chip stocks have caused sharp volatility in the Korean stock market this year. He attributed the market’s turbulence to the semiconductor sector’s larger share of Korea’s economy compared with other countries, but he still maintained that the Korean economy’s fundamentals remain solid.

A commentary piece in Korea’s leading business daily, the Daily Economic News, published on Thursday, urged the government to prepare for a slowdown in the AI boom. Citing two experts, the article said that by 2029 a massive influx of semiconductor supply is expected, turning the memory‑chip market into a “red sea.”

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元逾1個月來首見單週跌幅 升息預期降溫、AI疑慮持續
items.title_en: <New York Forex> US Dollar Records First Weekly Decline in Over a Month as Rate‑Hike Expectations Cool and AI Concerns Persist
paras: 美元周五(16日)走低，兌歐元與日元均創下逾1個月來首見單週貶值，反映市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期降溫，以及投資人對AI引發股市賣壓的疑慮持續存在。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.17%，報101.87，本週下跌約0.35%。
本週公布的消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，一度令市場感到不安。不過，聯準會官員的談話顯示，目前沒有急於進一步緊縮貨幣政策的必要，有助於穩定美國公債殖利率，也削弱了美元的支撐力道。
AI類股本週大幅下跌，壓力也蔓延至部分信用市場。由於投資人已大量押注AI供應鏈各個環節，如今開始擔心資料中心營運商可能無法及時實現獲利，進而償還債務。
StoneX全球市場研究主管Matt Weller表示，「我認為今天乃至本週最值得關注的現象，是美元與AI交易之間的緊密連動。通常科技股遭到拋售時，市場會預期美元因避險需求而走強。我們確實看到部分資金流向債券，但美元實際上卻在下跌。」
本週英鎊與瑞士法郎兌美元的升幅居前。瑞士法郎受到避險需求支撐，市場也預期，即使利率環境進一步走低，瑞士仍不太可能將政策利率降至目前零利率以下。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.31%，至1英鎊兌1.3314美元，本週累計上漲0.63%。
美元兌瑞士法郎則下跌0.25%，至0.8246瑞郎，本週累計下跌0.67%。瑞郎在過去兩個交易日累計升值逾1.4%。
芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具顯示，市場預估聯準會本月稍晚維持利率不變的機率為83%，高於一個月前的49%。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)週五出席在曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金（IMF）與世界銀行年度會議時，並未透露未來利率決策的線索。他表示，自己不會「預先判斷」任何一次會議的決策。
紐約梅隆銀行宏觀經濟策略師John Velis表示，「我認為，目前聯準會決策委員會內部，尤其是理事們，尚未形成足夠共識支持10月升息。不過，12月是否升息仍是未解之題，從現在到那時還有許多事情可能發生。」
歐元區財政風險仍受關注
法國財政風險仍是市場關注的背景因素。10月初，法國債務風險溢價曾大幅攀升。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1歐元兌1.1227美元。歐元週四已上漲0.56%，創下兩個月來最大單日漲幅，全週上漲約0.23%。
投資人預期，美國總統川普將避免讓中東或烏克蘭局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能推升通膨，進而損害他在期中選舉前的政治支持度。
美元兌日元下跌0.08%，至158.11日元。日元終止連續四週貶值走勢，本週升值0.13%。此前，伊朗衝突支撐美元走強。
近期油價上漲推升美元，同時對歐元與日元等能源進口國貨幣造成壓力。
日本銀行（BOJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)週五再次強調，潛在通膨率可能超越央行設定的2%目標，仍是需要留意的風險。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Friday (the 16th), with both the euro and the yen posting their first weekly depreciation in more than a month, reflecting a cooling of market expectations for further Fed rate hikes and lingering investor worries that AI is weighing on equity markets.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.17% to 101.87, down about 0.35% for the week.

Consumer price and producer price data released this week came in above expectations, briefly unsettling markets. However, comments from Fed officials indicated no urgent need for further monetary tightening, helping to stabilise US Treasury yields and weakening support for the dollar.

AI‑related stocks fell sharply this week, and the pressure spread to parts of the credit market. Investors, who have heavily bet on every link of the AI supply chain, are now worried that data‑center operators may not generate profits quickly enough to service their debt.

Matt Weller, head of global market research at StoneX, said, "I think the most noteworthy phenomenon today and this week is the tight link between the dollar and AI trading. Usually when tech stocks are sold off, the market expects the dollar to strengthen on safe‑haven demand. We did see some flows into bonds, but the dollar actually fell."

The pound and the Swiss franc posted the biggest gains against the dollar this week. The franc was supported by safe‑haven demand, and markets expect that even if rates fall further, Switzerland is unlikely to push its policy rate below the current zero‑percent level.
The pound rose 0.31% to $1.3314, up 0.63% for the week.
The dollar slipped 0.25% against the Swiss franc to 0.8246 CHF, down 0.67% for the week. The franc had appreciated more than 1.4% over the past two trading days.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows the market now assigns an 83% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged later this month, up from 49% a month ago.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh attended the IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok on Friday and offered no clues about future rate decisions, saying he does not "pre‑judge" the outcome of any meeting.

John Velis, macro strategy strategist at BNY Mellon, said, "I think the Fed’s policy committee, especially the governors, have not yet reached sufficient consensus to support a rate hike in October. However, whether there will be a hike in December remains an open question, and many things could happen between now and then."
Euro‑area fiscal risks remain a focus.
Fiscal risk in France continues to be a background concern for markets, with French sovereign risk premiums spiking sharply in early October.
The euro rose 0.08% to $1.1227. It had gained 0.56% on Thursday, the biggest single‑day rise in two months, and is up about 0.23% for the week.

Investors expect that President Trump will try to avoid further escalation in the Middle East or Ukraine, as a larger conflict could push inflation higher and damage his political support ahead of the mid‑term elections.
The dollar fell 0.08% to ¥158.11, ending a four‑week streak of depreciation for the yen, which rose 0.13% this week. Previously, the Iran conflict had supported a stronger dollar.
Recent oil price gains have lifted the dollar while putting pressure on currencies of energy‑importing countries such as the euro and yen.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated on Friday that a potential inflation rate above the BOJ’s 2% target remains a risk to watch.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯不同調 續貶7.3分失守32.3元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Weakens While Stocks Hold, Falling 0.73 ¢ to Slip Below the 32.3 TWD Mark
paras: 在美元指數維持強勢、外資持續撤出亞洲市場影響下，新台幣兌美元今 (16) 日走弱，終場收在32.338元，貶值7.3分，續創近期波段低點，顯示國際資金仍偏向美元資產，相較於昨天的91億美元爆巨量，台北外匯經紀公司與元太外匯經紀公司合計總成交量為 46.12億美元。
儘管匯市承壓，台股表現相對有撐，加權指數終場收在47,111點，上漲141點，漲幅約0.3%，呈現匯弱股強格局。市場買盤主要聚焦 AI 伺服器、高階 PCB 及半導體供應鏈族群，在電子權值股支撐下，大盤成功守住漲勢。
從籌碼面來看，統計今日三大法人合計賣超約729億元，其中外資賣超高達494億元，已連續第8個交易日站在賣方；投信則持續扮演護盤角色，買超約132億元，寫下連6買；自營商賣超約367億元。
市場人士指出，本波新台幣轉弱主要受到美元升值效應帶動，近期美國經濟數據維持韌性，加上市場重新評估聯準會後續政策路徑，推升美元買盤，亞洲主要貨幣同步承壓，新台幣也不例外。資料顯示，10月以來新台幣已由31字頭一路走貶至32.3元以上水準。
觀察資金流向，外資近期持續調節台股權值股與電子類股部位，成為匯市與股市的重要變數。不過投信買盤明顯進場承接，加上AI相關產業基本面未見轉弱，因此支撐台股維持高檔震盪格局。今天市場呈現「匯率偏空、股市偏多」，除外資匯出導致台幣走弱，加上AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進封裝需求仍強，吸引國內資金與長線買盤進駐，使台股維持相對強勢。
paras_en: Under a strong US dollar index and continued foreign‑capital outflows from Asian markets, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar today (Oct 16), closing at 32.338 TWD, down 0.73 ¢ and extending its recent low‑point swing, indicating that international funds remain biased toward dollar assets. In contrast to yesterday’s massive USD 91 billion turnover, Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers and Yuan‑Tai FX brokers together handled a total volume of USD 46.12 billion.

Despite pressure on the currency market, Taiwan’s equity market showed relative resilience, with the weighted index closing at 47,111 points, up 141 points or about 0.3%, reflecting a “weak currency, strong stocks” pattern. Buying interest centered on AI servers, high‑end PCBs and semiconductor supply‑chain groups, and the rally in heavyweight electronics stocks helped the market maintain its upward momentum.

From a flow perspective, the three major institutional investors sold a combined net NT$729 billion today, with foreign investors leading the sell‑side at NT$494 billion for the eighth consecutive trading day. Trust funds continued to play a stabilising role, net‑buying about NT$132 billion for the sixth straight session, while proprietary traders sold roughly NT$367 billion.

Market observers said the recent weakening of the Taiwan dollar is mainly driven by the dollar’s appreciation. Recent US economic data remain resilient and the market’s reassessment of the Fed’s policy path has boosted dollar demand, putting pressure on major Asian currencies, including the TWD. Data show that since October the Taiwan dollar has slid from the low‑31s to above the 32.3 TWD level.

Looking at capital flows, foreign investors have been adjusting their positions in Taiwan’s heavyweight and electronics stocks, becoming a key variable for both the FX and equity markets. However, trust‑fund buying is evident, and the fundamentals of AI‑related industries have not weakened, supporting the Taiwan stock market’s high‑level range‑bound pattern. Today’s market displayed a “bearish currency, bullish equity” stance: foreign outflows weakened the TWD, while strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging kept domestic and long‑term buying interest in equities, allowing the stock market to stay relatively strong.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.45% to 101.99. Earlier, U.S. inflation data came in above expectations, pushing the index to an 18‑month peak on Wednesday.

U.S. September producer prices (PPI) rose at the fastest pace in four and a half years, with costs for goods and services climbing together, further showing inflation pressure spreading from the energy sector to other areas.

Last month’s retail sales growth exceeded expectations, driven mainly by higher gasoline prices, while initial unemployment claims rose slightly, indicating consumer demand remains resilient and the labor market stays stable.
However, U.S. Treasury prices rose and the dollar retreated, reflecting recent cautious remarks from Federal Reserve officials that further lowered market expectations of a rate hike in October.

Juan Perez, head of trading at Monex USA, said, "There is currently a narrative that is unfavorable to the dollar because if inflation stays at this level and rises this quickly, it will be hard to sustain."

He added, "Whether there is no good news on the war front or the equity outlook looks bleak, after the dollar’s strong run over the past four weeks the market still tends to sell the greenback… stagnation seems to have a bigger impact on traders’ thinking."
AI companies' debt burdens draw attention
The dollar’s decline lifted the euro, which rose 0.56% against the dollar from an 18‑month low to $1.1218, marking the biggest single‑day gain in nearly two months.
The pound rose 0.64% to $1.3275 after data showed the U.K. economy unexpectedly grew 0.1% in August.

Wednesday’s U.S. consumer price index (CPI) came in above expectations, initially boosting bets that the Fed would keep rates high for longer. At the same time, renewed worries about heavy debt loads at AI firms prompted a flow into safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries, intensifying market volatility.

Uto Shinohara, senior investment strategist at Mesirow Currency Management, said, "The sell‑off in chip stocks provided support for bonds, keeping yields at relatively controlled levels and offsetting the impact of inflation signals."
The CME Group FedWatch tool shows traders now assign a 73% probability that the Fed will leave rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 53% a month ago.

After the CPI report, the market’s probability of a rate hike surged, but Fed Vice‑Chair Michelle Bowman and San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly said the Fed could wait for clearer information before deciding, cooling the market’s rate‑hike bets.

LMAX Group market strategist Joel Kruger said, "If yields struggle to rise further and the dollar keeps getting sold each time it rebounds, it reinforces our view that inflation news has largely been priced in and the overall risk balance will favor risky assets."
Investors will also watch Friday for comments from Fed officials at the IMF and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, including Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, for clues on the central bank’s next move.
The Australian dollar fell 0.77% to $0.6919 after September job numbers in Australia unexpectedly dropped.
The yen appreciated 0.15% to 158.08 per dollar.

Shinohara noted, "The Fed is entering a pre‑meeting quiet period, and no major economic data will be released before the meeting, so market moves may still be influenced by geopolitical uncertainties related to Russia, Ukraine, Iran, and the development of the AI industry."
